row.name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
row.detailed_description: TACTICAL EXTRACTION Arena Breakout: Infinite (ABI) has meticulously crafted 5 distinctive maps - the Farm, the Valley, the Northridge, the Armory, and the TV Station - with each demanding a radical shift in raid strategy. Sprint through the tight Valley corridors for hit-and-run strikes or plan a tactical siege in the Armory’s block-by-block warzone. But pay attention, nature doesn’t play by your rules - everchanging weather in the Dark Zone can alter every extraction into a new desperate gamble. Outthink, outgun, and extract - before the zone swallows you whole. HYPER-REALISTIC, EFFORTLESS MASTERY Arena Breakout: Infinite respects the depth military fans crave while welcoming newcomers with the red carpet treatment. For the die-hard military enthusiasts, this is a love letter to authenticity. Our Ultimate Gunsmith System features over 900 weapon mods on over 20 attachment slots to allow you to create your ultimate custom weapon. For newcomers, we’ve built in quality-of-life features like one-tap loadouts that let you gear up in seconds. Arena Breakout: Infinite strips away frustration so you can focus on the loot ‘n shoot fun. RUN SOLO OR WITH YOUR SQUAD Arena Breakout: Infinite offers a variety of game modes for all operators - Tactical Ops, Solo Ops, Covert Ops and fast-paced 4v4 Deathmatch modes. Whether you prefer tactical teamwork or going in alone, you decide how you take on the fight. TROPHY ROOM & PROGRESSION The Trophy Room is your off-field stronghold, where every upgrade and decoration tells your story. That rare sniper rifle, a stack of high-tier armor, or a collection of enemy dog tags - showcase all your hard-earned loot with pride! Here, progression never stops and each season brings fresh challenges - complete weekly and seasonal tasks to unlock rewards that grow with your lethal reputation. The crown jewel? A free, top-tier 3X3 Titanium Case ensuring your most valuable loot stays safe no matter how tough the raid gets. FAIR PLAY AND ANTI-CHEAT In Arena Breakout: Infinite, fair combat isn’t just a promise - it’s a guarantee with our ever-improving, anti-cheat system. This includes Killcam Replays that allow you to submit a one-tap report whenever you flag suspicious activity. Moreover, we don’t just punish cheaters - we make it right for you. If you’re confirmed to have lost loot, gear, or a match due to cheating, automatic in-game compensation will hit your inventory. Last year alone, our anti-cheat system placed 10-year bans to punish over 123,000 players, and reimbursed over 630,000 players with over 400 Billion Koens.
row.short_description: Arena Breakout: Infinite is a high-stakes tactical extraction shooter where every decision matters. Fight, loot, and extract—or lose it all. With stunningly realistic visuals, lifelike sound, and unforgiving PvPvE combat, every raid is a gamble between glory and ruin.

row.name: Blocks of Nature
row.detailed_description: Blocks of Nature is a casual puzzle game. The objective is to combine three or more cubes of the same color and to keep scoring until cubes build up too high. Beware of the cold Winter has come. Cubes that fall on the ice block on the ground or touch other frozen cubes will freeze over time. Once frozen, they cannot be broken unless they are melted with lava cubes. However, lava cubes are rare, so use them wisely... Lava cubes cool over time and turn into rocks. These rocks can be removed by combining atleast three of them together, like normal cubes. Temperature falls as you gain levels, so cubes will freeze faster and lava cubes cool down faster too. For unknown reasons, as the temperature drops, it conveniently also makes cubes to drop faster. Maybe it´s the magic of Lapland? Rainbows to the rescue Rainbow cube is a special, but unfortunately a very rare cube. It will destroy every unfrozen cube of the same color that it lands on. It works for lavacubes too! Extra 100 points are granted if you are brave enough to land it on frozen cube or on the ice on the ground (It won´t do you any good, but hey, 100 points!). Casual or competitive? Seemingly so casual game can find itself being quite competitive if you challenge your friends in this game! There is an ingame online leaderboard too!
row.short_description: Combine cubes of the same color in a lapland-inspired scene with bright visuals and relaxing music for casual gameplay

Based off of the wildly popular horror game, Five Nights at Freddy's, you will spend one night trapped in a prison, forced to defend yourself against Barney and many of his colleagues. Spend your night checking the hallways, vents, and cameras, collecting materials to craft and upgrade the tools at your disposal, and discovering secrets to alter the endgame. However there are no doors. Instead you are equipped with a EERG-15 Shotgun. Works like a charm...until you run out of bullets.

row.name: OrbiTank
row.detailed_description: Tanks! Space! Tanks in space! Does much more even need to be said? OrbiTank is a local-multiplayer tank game with a fresh spin on projectile combat. Use gravity to your advantage to shoot your shells in and out of orbit, hop from planet to planet, and dive bomb your enemies. Explore a vast variety of arenas which feature several gravitational mechanics such as planets, orbiting moons, spinning space stations, and even treacherous black holes. Classic The classic game mode is good old reliable. You can't go wrong! It's just you, a friend, and the most balanced version of the game that has been experimented with. Players have three lives per round, and in order to win it all, you must rack up five points. Points are collected by winning levels, and levels will continue to be generated until either player wins the game. Usually a game in the classic game mode will last about 10 minutes, or until your friend starts to call your mother names. Tournament With the tournament game mode, you can challenge a whole group of friends to your mega epic gamer skills. Winner gets to not be made fun of for playing MOBAs. No, but seriously. Although no more than two players will ever be hashing it out on the screen at once, tournaments can be generated with up to eight contestants. This is a great game mode for parties and does not disappoint as a fun time sink. Expect hoots and hollers. Custom Trying to shake things up? Then this is just the game mode for you! You can modify several balancing settings using the custom game mode. This means if you want a really long game but it switches levels after every time a player is killed, you can do that. If you want to speed or slow down the fire rate to make the game more arcade-like or more tactical, you have the options. And, finally, my favorite, you have the ability to turn the planet movement up to like, a lot a lot. Prepare yourself for ludicrous speed.
row.short_description: Local multiplayer tanks in space!

row.name: SHAFTED

Build a variety of harvesters, each providing a unique production bonus. Manage 4 primary minerals: Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold. Each resource has a special purpose in your colony. Optimize Each mineshaft has a new optimization challenge. CONFIGURE optimal paths to maximize profits. SPEND from your bank to upgrade equipment. PRIORITIZE or else you'll get SHAFTED! Turn Based Tactics PLAN the placement of your units every day. No time limit. REACT to the alien client's attacks. (RUDE Clients!) Manage grid expansions on future stages!
row.short_description: SHAFTED is a QUICK resource management game. Build your mini mining colony. Optimize your mineral outputs. Strategically position your buildings with turn based tactics. Pay off your contracts or else you'll get SHAFTED.

row.name: Silent Seeker
row.detailed_description: SOCIAL NETWORKS DISCORD SERVER About the Game Welcome to Silent Seeke r, the exciting multiplayer prop hunt game where you'll experience the thrill of hiding and seeking with friends! Become either a crafty Prop or a relentless Hunter and test your skills in an intense battle of stealth and strategy. BEING A PROP As BRUMBLE , your task is to blend in seamlessly with the environment by disguising yourself as everyday objects. Transform into furniture or household items scattered across carefully designed maps. But beware! One wrong move could give away your position and alert the Hunters. As a Prop, finding a smart hiding spot and staying perfectly still is essential. Utilize your surroundings to outsmart the Hunters and survive. Will you manage to stay hidden until the time runs out, or will you succumb to the Hunter's keen eye? BEING AN HUNTER On the other hand, embrace the role of a determined Hunter with FURY ! Use your sharp senses to track down and eliminate the elusive Props. You have three different attacks at your disposal, each with unique damage and cooldown times. Coordinate with other Hunters, communicate effectively, and devise clever strategies to corner and eliminate the Props. Props can use the environment to their advantage, making every match a thrilling test of skill, teamwork, and deception. Silent Seeker also features a chat system, allowing you to communicate with your teammates and opponents. Additionally, immerse yourself in the action with a proximity voice chat, where you can strategize with teammates or taunt your opponents in real-time. Are you ready for an exhilarating multiplayer prop hunt adventure like no other? Gather your friends, sharpen your senses, and dive into the heart-pounding world of Silent Seeker . The clock is ticking, the Props are hiding, and the Hunters are closing in. Will you be the master of deception or the ultimate seeker?
row.short_description: Silent Seeker is a Hide & Seek multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!

row.name: Bloom: Roots of Renewal
row.detailed_description: The mystic forest is blooming and ancient evils have returned. Only the Tome of Power hidden in the ancient Archives contain the answers to how to defeat these forces. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures. Game Details Thrilling Old School Combat Fight foes big and small as you navigate the forest in search of the Tome of Power. Evade tiny spiders, out-maneuver teleporting magicians, and find the perfect vantage point to take out your air-based foes. Unique Magical Environments From an overgrown forest to a forgotten library, from the depths of the caves to the heights of the mountains, navigate through the magic-infested world. Enjoy exploring a rich and varied landscaped filled with secrets and treasures to collect. Wide Arsenal of Weapons Battle your enemies with a wide selection of eight unique weapons, including shotguns, snipers, and heavy machine guns. Switch between them as you manage your ammo and find the right weapon for the job. About This Game Bloom: Roots of Renewal is created by the WolverineSoft Studio at the University of Michigan, a voluntary student games studio. It is an educational case study on Bethesda's Quake, and takes inspiration from its game mechanics as well as other games in the genre. Bloom: Roots of Renewal was developed by a team of 20 students. The development took place over a period of 8 months.
row.short_description: Bloom: Roots of Renewal is a first person shooter inspired by Hexen and Quake. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures.

row.name: 焰色方糖 flamed sugar
row.detailed_description: Flamed Sugar is a visual novel with light puzzle solving elements, which tells several independent stories. You can usually drag the components in the game to a reasonable position, and all puzzle solving methods are included in the game. We focus on the beauty and harmony of the writing style and the open freehand brushwork of the art style. We are very sorry that this game only supports Chinese for the time being.
row.short_description: Flamed Sugar is a visual novel with light puzzle solving elements, which tells several independent stories.

row.detailed_description: 《只爱三国》是回合制战斗模式加即时国战控制策略游戏，超大实感地图，智能多部队行军，丰富的战斗体验和多样的内政玩法，给你带来不一样的体验！ 再现经典三国战场，指挥多路名将阵容， 多样的武将培养方向，丰富的装备提升体系，辅助美人提供全方位挂机体验，无尽的战法搭配，特色的宝物羁绊，可打造多路精致部队，无论单服争霸，还是跨服互动，都能让你在热血战场中全线出击，荣耀四方！ 还有多重平台上线专属福利送不停： 1、上线即领：SVIP1、元宝*8888，银两*888W、抽奖券*88、福利宝箱*1 2、创角礼包码：KPZFFASBNZ0ROHU，奖励：玫瑰花 5;高级经验书 5;辅助之心 5;声望 500; 3、独家礼包码：KQZFEBSBMZVGQAR，奖励：高级招贤榜 1;将魂 1000;美人约函 5;充值元宝 200; 4、进阶礼包码：KRZFEATBMZNQXQS，奖励：精炼石 5;神将修炼丹 5;将魂 1000;玫瑰花 5; 5、豪华礼包码：KSZEEBTBNZ3T0IX，奖励：红装万能碎片 10;魔将修炼丹 10;声望 2000;美人约函 20; 礼包码请领码后前往游戏主界面－福利大厅－礼包兑换。

row.name: The First Descendant
row.detailed_description: PLAY FREE NOW About the Game The First Descendant is a free third-person cooperative action RPG shooter featuring high-quality graphics. Experience the fun of strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op and various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting. A variety of equipment is necessary for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. The player becomes a Descendant in the game and is given a mission to fight against the invaders for the survival of humans and to protect the ‘Ingris continent’. The player can experience a spectacular story by growing stronger through various missions and stories to finally discover the Descendants' secret. You can also feel the First Descendant’s unique atmosphere through high-quality fields developed with Unreal Engine 5 and gain a new experience of reality and SF fantasy coexisting in one place. Charming and Unique Characters You can play various characters with distinctive concepts and battle styles. We plan to add various customizable elements such as skins for each character to support character decoration. Exciting Battles and Dynamic Action Using Various Skills and Firearms Experience the First Descendant’s exciting battles composed of various characters with unique skill sets, free movements, and chain actions through Grappling Hooks, colorful firearms, and additional effects. With these, the player can create any battle style they desire. Battles With Huge Boss Monsters Through Cooperative Play You can target huge boss monsters with different appearances and abilities through 4 player co-op play. The various difficulties will stimulate your competitive spirit, and you can destroy or extract various parts of the huge bosses through 4-player cooperative play. By targeting the huge boss’s gimmicks, you will be able to experience a more compact team play. Motivating Play and Growth You can equip a character with 3 guns, 4 secondary accessories, and various sub-weapons. Of course, there will also be items to enhance a character or their firearm stats or add a new ability all together. A variety of equipment is a necessary element for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game, or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. We provide equipment so you can develop the characters to play continuously through character growth and acquiring and combining the various equipment. Use it to challenge yourself with more difficult tasks and enjoy the thrill of clearing them.
row.short_description: The First Descendant is a third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Become a Descendant. Fight for the survival of humanity. Descendants have unique abilities to tackle both solo and co-op missions. Up to 4 players use varied mechanics to defeat giant bosses. BE THE FIRST DESCENDANT!
row.notes: The First Descendant is a TPS (Third-Person Shooter), which contains violence involving guns & explosives against monsters similar or not to human beings, repetitive yet not too intense. The blood effects displayed when being attacked or attacking an opponent are not realistic but accompany VFX/SFX.

row.name: The First Descendant Final Technical Test
PewPew Live
row.detailed_description: PewPew Live is a twin-stick shooter with retro vector graphics where you compete for the best scores . Emphasis is put on the speed and diversity of the gameplay. Comes with 5 different built-in levels and dozens of levels created by other players! Online leaderboards, with replays of every score. Retro-futurist vector graphics. Unlockable ships, bullets and trails. 2 player co-op: online or over LAN.
row.short_description: A fast twin-stick shooter where you compete for the top spot in the leaderboards.

row.name: Catch Royale
row.detailed_description: Conquer the Catch Royale's everchanging seasonal maps as a hunter and catch them foxes or flip the coin, show your inner escape artist, and choose to be part of the foxes team. The concept is plain and simple: The hunters' task is to tag them foxes, aka catch them, as the name indicates. However, the longer you survive as a fox, the higher your reward is. Various settings, various parameters: Try out Party mode, in which, instead of the standard 100-player mode, you can battle amongst 250 other fighters. For the full experience, we added an optional Smart AI mode, in which you can set the other AI-handled foxes and hunters to find the optimal route to simulate the best experience. What can I do with my XP? The game offers 20 skins you can earn as you go up the staircase of experience points, each with a 5000 XP gap. Future features that are yet to come: Plain multiplayer mode Replay mode Create and publish your levels
row.short_description: Remember playing tag? We spiced it up a little bit: Immerse yourself in Catch Royale: A stylized free-to-play Battle-Royale game with up to 250 players.

row.name: Flowa
row.detailed_description: Gather flowers in 100 meticulously crafted levels Unlock and complete challenging hidden bonus levels Achieve tricky bonus goals on every level, with many unique varieties (think 'crack all the ice in the level' or 'jump at least five times') Experiment with tons of different objects, including teleporters, freeze bombs, blocks of slime, and dark matter that 'voids' anything it touches Access an additional 100 challenges in a difficult optional postgame
row.short_description: A relaxing 2D puzzle game about watering and collecting flowers. Plan an efficient route to the goal, complete bonus challenges, and collect as many flowers as you can!

row.name: Sunday Gold: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Sunday Gold: Prologue Get stuck into the opening chapters of Sunday Gold. In this prologue, you’ll step into the shoes of down-on-his-luck hardman Frank Barber, form up your band of misfits and set out on your next job: exposing the dark secrets of Hogan Industries. Experience a unique hybrid of escape room style puzzles, turn-based combat, and RPG mechanics tied together with a dark and cinematic storyline. Delve into the dark underbelly of near-future London Once bustling and full of life, the city of London is in a dark and dismal state. Unemployment and homelessness are at an all-time high. Ethical boundaries are being stretched to their limit and corrupt billionaire, Kenny Hogan, is up to no good. It’s up to ragtag band of criminals Frank, Sally, and Gavin, to put a wrench in Kenny Hogan’s plans and bring him to his knees. But this is no simple job and there’ll be a smattering of obstacles they’ll have to face along the way… Lose yourself in a dark and dystopian story Immerse yourself in a gritty and graphic world with a storyline narrated by fully voice-acted characters. Experience stunningly hand-drawn environments, 2D cinematics and comic book inspired sequences as well as cliff hangers that will keep you on your toes. Puzzles that will get you scratching your noggin Explore each room and solve a combination of observation, deduction, and inventory puzzles to progress on your mission. Hunt for clues, hack terminals, bust down a door (or two) and test your wits in mini game challenges unique to each “hero”. Stylish turn-based combat inspired by comic books Face off against your opponents in stylish and cinematic RPG style battles. Each team member possesses their own unique set of skills as well as their own strengths and weaknesses. Plan your moves strategically, master winning combos and kick your enemies to the curb. Keep your composure and try not to sweat Battle your own stress levels as well as enemies! Disturbing and pressured situations will wear down your characters’ composure causing them to act impulsively. Maintain your composure with consumables and leadership abilities. Lose your mind, lose the mission! A modern twist on point-and-click games Sunday Gold takes the traditional elements of a point-and-click game and mixes them with fierce RPG combat and a gritty storyline.
row.short_description: Sunday Gold is a point-and-click, turn-based adventure game set in grim, dystopian future. Play as a ragtag trio of criminals to hunt down and expose the dark secrets of an evil mega-corporation and the malevolent billionaire behind it.
row.notes: Mature Content: - Violence with weapons and hand to hand combat. - Excessive swearing. - Experimentations on humans and animals. - Morgue scene featuring body parts. - Crime scene featuring bloody aftermath of crime.

row.name: Protocol Xeno
row.detailed_description: Earth has suddenly been thrust into the center of a galactic warzone, and now you must take charge and prepare mighty defenses. The aliens never let up for long, so you must carefully divide your attention between combating them and spending your resources. You may crush aliens with the moon or overwhelm them with your extreme partying, but they will only grow stronger. How long can you hold them off? Key Features Extreme Combat - Build weapons that dwarf even the largest mountains and fight aliens the size of planets. Resource Management - Spend your resources wisely for what upgrades you pick could mean the difference between a quick death and glorious survival. Ever Growing Challenge - The longer you survive, the stronger your enemies will become. Permadeath - Once the Earth has shattered, it's over, and you must once more build up your defenses using your new knowledge and skills. High Scores - Skilled players can aim for high scores, which challenge them to act fast and never give the aliens a break.
row.short_description: This hectic twin-stick shooter will force you to balance blowing up massive alien warships and growing your monumental arsenal. How long can you survive in this galactic brawl?

row.name: Han'yo
row.detailed_description: Han’yo is a 2d side scrolling combat game that tells the story of Hiroko, a young samurai girl from ancient Japan. After witnessing her village being destroyed and slaughtered by the Oni, Hiroko has only one goal: revenge. Join her on a journey to find the Oni and avenge her people. Ancient Japanese themed fantasy inspired graphical style with ink Traditional samurai duels, where quick reactions will decide your fate Enjoy the visually calm feeling and the tension provided by the fast combats, providing lethal combat choreographies Languages: English, Spanish, Italian, German, Catalan, Basque Han'yo is a project developed by Hangover Studios, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.
row.short_description: After witnessing her village being destroyed and slaughtered by the Oni demon, Hiroko has only one goal: revenge. Join this young samurai in this 2D side-scrolling platformer.

row.name: VANQUISH
row.detailed_description: VANQUISH your enemies in this deeply challenging isometric arcade shooter. Awaken ashore and enter the fray with reckless abandon as Gruegus, the furious close-quarters fighter—or take a more tactical approach with Zarus, the shamanic magician. Find new weapons and abilities to augment or overhaul each character's distinct playstyle, and fight to your last breath while unravelling the mystery of this uncanny, mist-mired island.
row.short_description: This is Vanquish! A top-down pixel art shooter where you play as either an Orc Warrior or a Gnome Magician which have both crashed onto a cursed island.

row.name: Utomah
row.detailed_description: Utomah is a 2D platformer in which the player, a boy with a parasitic creature stuck to his head, navigates through a nightmarish world. Grapple, latch, and dash through incredible environments, discovering the darkness of one's inner mind, encountering true horrors along the way. With memorable bosses, challenging fast-paced encounters, and unique level structures, prepare to push your skills to the limit! Surreal environments to traverse! Can you make it through this unforgiving world? Three bosses that will push your platforming and combat skills to the limits! A world like you've never seen before! Everything you see was hand-drawn with charcoal. Immersive audio! Surely those creepy noises are coming from the game...right? This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Utomah is a 2D platformer in which the player navigates through a nightmarish world. Grapple, latch, and dash through incredible environments, discovering the darkness of one's inner mind, encountering true horrors along the way. Prepare to push your skills to the limit!

row.name: The Last Metal Shooter
row.detailed_description: the Last Metal Shooter is a 2d Game art style run and gun action game focused on wave battles with the enemies and fighting using different weapons that can be selected and changed during the fights. 'Game Missions' the Main Game Mode is the 'Game Missions' as the game has 5 main challenging missions with different kind of environment that it get harder by going forward in the game progress, the more you proceed further the more you meet different type of enemies and different challenges. each level has an ending fight as a boss fight or a hard enemy waves to stand and defeat. 'Game Key Features' besides running, jumping and shooting skills that need to use during the game, still need to utilize the token that being collected to enhance the weapons or the health such as weapons upgrades that need to find the upgrades token and upgrade the weapons to get stronger guns, and also there is money tokens that need to be collected and can be used to purchase health, Life. 'How to Win' the main thing in the game is to survive and stand in the battles against the enemies by dodging the attacks, and the game main goal is to proceed to the level ending and fight the last battle till you reach to the final boss and defeat him then you can say you completed the game missions.
row.short_description: the Last Metal Shooter is a 2d Game art style run and gun action game focused on wave battles with the enemies and fighting using different weapons that can be selected and changed during the fights.

row.name: 明日、初めて彼女と❤
row.detailed_description: ❤Story❤ A cute and kind girlfriend I met on SNS. I'm finally going on a date with her tomorrow and really looking forward to it! But the next day, Who do you think appeared at the meeting place...? At 4 date spots, Experience a slightly real and laughable date with her! ❤Feature❤ ・You can date your UNIQUE girlfriend with this game system. ・Because it is a casual volume, you can play quickly. ・You can play FIRST DATE with the same girl as many times as you want. ・Of course it's a multi-ending game!
row.short_description: With your unique girlfriend, exciting first date ADV❤

row.name: Energy Tail
row.detailed_description: Energy Tail is an oldschool arcade game where you fight enemies in relentless arena battles. You take control over a blue vectoid, which tries to stop the invasion of enemy vectoids into its realm. To defeat its enemies, the blue vectoid is able to create a deadly tail while moving, allowing it to let the enemies crash into its tail. However, the same is true for the enemy vectoids. The tron-inspired mechanic is simple to learn and hard to master, allowing for fast-paced arcade action that demands precision as well as quick reactions. Can you seal the breaches and stop the invasion? Fast-paced arcade action that requires quick reactions and high precision Simple game mechanics that are easy to learn and hard to master An abstract realm with elegant graphics 3 hand-crafted difficulty levels The hard difficulty poses a real challenge 20 levels offering a variety of enemy types Endless mode
row.short_description: Energy Tail is an oldschool arcade game where you fight enemies in relentless arena battles. It's free, so go and give it a try!

row.name: TrainFormation
row.detailed_description: TrainFormation is a simple, fast-paced puzzle game created by one student as a university project. Place rails in front of an ever-accelerating train to cross procedurally generated levels, reach stations, collect power ups and make it as far as you can! Build a path for the train Swap hexagonal tiles to create a path for the train. Make sure to find the matching rails and terrain, or the train will not make it through! ⠀ Reach stations and collect power ups Make it to a station and take a moment to breathe. Use specific rail tiles to collect power ups to help you in your toughest moments! ⠀ Make it as far as you can Reach new levels and face the difficult terrain. Hold on tight as the train continues to accelerate! ⠀
row.short_description: TrainFormation is a simple, fast-paced puzzle game created by one student as a university project. Place rails in front of an ever-accelerating train to cross procedurally generated levels, reach stations, collect power ups and make it as far as you can!

row.name: SCP: Daybreak
row.detailed_description: THE GAME IS BEING REVAMPED HEAVILY! EXPECT UPDATES BY 2026! .---- .---- .-.-.- .---- .---- .-.-.- ..--- ----- ..--- .....
row.short_description: An open-ended, SCP-based, atmospheric, exploration-focused, survival-horror game with puzzle elements and replayability.
row.notes: THis Product includes Extreme Violence and Gore.

row.name: Koa: The Forgotten Gods
row.detailed_description: Just Updated The game is designed to be played with a controller , if your are playing on keyboard you can add 'US English Layout' in windows . About the Game Koa the Forgotten Gods is a 2022 graduation game developed by a team of 7 students from ISART Digital Montreal. The goal of the experience is to provide a feeling of overpower to the player through a combat system based on the flow of movement. With abilities granted by the gods emphasizing the fluidity of movement, we invite the player to explore the world and history of a rich culture. Narration A story of passion inspired by the Hawaiian legend of Ohia Lehua. Play as Kalena, the cursed warrior, who lost her village and her lover to the explosive jealousy of Tūtū Pele, the forgotten goddess of volcanoes. Combat Possessed by the curse of Tutu Pele that Kalena manifests into wings, engage in fluid and fast-paced combat as you ravage the defenders of the Jungle. Prove yourself to the forgotten gods through their challenges and obtain their blessing to propel you forward with greater speed and power. Environment Explore the dense jungles, lush moutain peaks and rich caverns this Hawaiian tropical island has to offer with life and vibrant colors. Found on the island are multiple mythological areas describing the power of each gods you will encounter in a beautiful and serene display of divinity.
row.short_description: Become Kalena, a warrior who finds herself pursuing her revenge against the goddess of volcanoes, travel through the fantastic islands of the Pacific, seek the blessings of the Forgotten Gods and fight Tiki minions to dispel the curse that gnaws at you.

row.name: Captain Gazman Day Of The Rage - Development Beta
GogMagog
row.detailed_description: Play as the cyber Messiah as you bring judgment upon legions of heretics at the Armageddon. Build a deck of powerful abilities, scale up your gameplay with Artifacts and create powerful synergies to smite the sinners! Build your deck GogMagog brings a unique blend between the Twin stick shooter and Deckbuilding genres. While progressing in your run you will find additional cards that will create powerful combos with existing cards and overall snowballing your character to greatness, as well as card upgrades and artifacts that will synergize your deck. Plan your hand You only have 2 cards at your disposal in a given time, and each card brings a different type of action into the game whether it’s damage or utility you must plan accordingly. Using the wrong card at the wrong time might be the end of the run! Roguelike By combining cards with artifacts you’ll create a unique play-style, from melee to summoner builds or be a tank of holy retribution. When you die you’ll come back to a new set of challenges and a new build to smite the heretics with. Bring judgment In GogMagog there is no moment of rest for the savior, as the cyber Messiah you will be bombarded with massive waves of non-stopping heretics & demons that evolve with time and as the apocalypse becomes closer, so does the difficulty of saving the world.
row.short_description: Play as the cyber-messiah as you bring judgment upon legions of heretics at the Armageddon. Build a deck of powerful abilities, scale up your gameplay with artifacts and create powerful synergies to smite the sinners!

row.name: Vespa's Test
row.detailed_description: To see the future is hard, but to see yourself is even harder. Vespa's test is a short, atmospheric personality test. During your time meeting with the titular and inquisitive Vespa, you'll answer a variety of questions about your life and the way you view the world, after which she'll attempt to read your present, and see what your greatest demons look like. There are numerous different outcomes, each of which is tailored from the answers you provide. What you choose to do with the insights provided, of course, is the greatest choice of all. Bagdul, city of Sapphires. A modern kingdom flanked for miles by sand and dust. Playground of the rich, resting place of the poor, and herald of the new millennium, with mysteries and secrets around every corner. One night, you follow a tip from a friend to a shady back-alley tucked between shadows. There, you find a out-of-place circus tent shrouded in the drippings of another world. What awaits within? Only one way to find out... Short and relaxing ~15 minutes playtime Answer over 100 introspective questions Various results depending on how you answer Completely free The results and questions are loosely based on psychologists Jeffrey E. Young, Ph.D. and Janet S. Klosko, Ph.D.'s concepts of 'lifetraps', which attempt to model patterns of behavior that hold us back in life, but you couldn't possibly know that, could you?
row.short_description: Vespa's Test is a short, relaxing personality test based on real psychological research. Answer a multitude of thought-provoking questions, and receive a vision tailored to your answers; what, in life, is holding you back?

row.name: Third Power
row.detailed_description: Third Power is a twist on the traditional puzzler, where players must balance alternating between two distinct forms and use the unique abilities of each in order to advance through a mysterious and dangerous cave system. You’ll have to dodge traps and monsters, deflect projectiles, and decipher clues as you puzzle your way through the numerous stone chambers, each of which boasts unique challenges to overcome in order to progress. Creative Puzzles Each area presents new and exciting elements to discover. You’ll have to rely on the powers associated with each of your forms to figure out how to get through to the next room. From hidden panels to mysterious switches to manipulating projectiles to traversing mazes, there is no shortage of exciting brain teasers and satisfying solutions laid out before you. Dangerous Foes Keep your eyes up - or you might get encased by jelly! You may have to dodge a wolf that can manipulate your very form, too. Keep your wits about you and make the best use of your powers to avoid the creatures that defend these enchanted halls. Mysterious Lore As you make your way through the perilous chambers ahead, you’ll uncover hints of a curse laid over the area, threatening anyone who dares move through the caves to satisfy their desire for fame or treasure. Will you be the first to achieve your goals without succumbing to the curse? Uncover the secrets of the tomb, before it’s too late...
row.short_description: Third Power is a unique puzzle adventure where players alternate between forms with distinct abilities in order to progress through a mysterious tomb. Avoid traps, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of an enigmatic curse as you advance toward discovering your third—and final—power.

row.name: Mushroom Musical
row.detailed_description: Bounce to the beat of different music genres, and save your missing mushroom friends! Mushroom Musical is a colorful platformer game, with two game modes: adventure and challenge. In adventure mode, you are searching for your mushroom friends through forests, fields, oceans and factories. The better you are in adventure mode, the more skins and adventure/challenge levels you unlock. Each adventure level has its own music genre. Examples of level names: Jellyfish Jazz, Bumblebee Blues. The challenge levels is where you can test yourself to see for how long you can avoid enemies. If you get good at it, it´s also a way to unlock skins. There are 3 worlds, 9 adventure levels, 1 boss level, and 3 challenge levels. This game is also available on android. Wishlist the next game in the same genre: Balls & Beats!
row.short_description: A colorful and difficult rhythm platformer game.

row.name: Eremidia - Archivist's Curse
row.detailed_description: Wishlist Insurgence - Bloodmoon! Click the images for more information, and don't forget Add to your Steam Wishlist now! Join or Discord Server! About the Game Archivist's Curse brings you into an otherworldly harbor of knowledge: The Great Library, although unfortunately, you ended up in the dangerous section of the complex called Hall of Pawnsmoor. To escape from the Hall, you have to take the test from The Chessmaster, Hall's current proprietor. Before you face The Chessmaster, you need to find companions who, fortunately, may come from Hall's own collection. Enter the Library's murky Dark Alleys to find companions, items, and clues on Hall's history as well as its owner. Fight against numerous intruders from within the Library as well as from the outside realm, and ultimately, defeat The Chessmaster to obtain your freedom and escape from Hall of Pawnsmoor. Synopsis: The 'Chessmaster of Pars Mythos' has invited you to play his game of chess--or that's what he wants you to believe. His game is not mere chess, however; you're required to find your own chess pieces, as he will also bring his own pieces. In order to find your own pieces, you need to delve into the murky, once-forbidden Hall of Pawnsmoor. Luckily, you will be assisted by another unexpected guest--one of the Scribes who happens to have knowledge about what the Hall has to offer. Know your pieces, learn about his game's rules, and best the Chessmaster in his own game, for it's the only way to release yourself from the Hall's succumbing imprisonment. Features: Two game modes: Chessmaster Match, where your mettle is tested; and Dark Alley, where you explore the Great Library for resources and unlockable companion pieces. It has its own tutorial segments, separated from the main game modes, too. Grid Battle System; fight various enemies on a chess-like battlefield. A slow tactic-like battle mechanics that emphasize position and proper abilities usage, since the battlefield can be affected by any present pieces. Dozens of unique, playable companions; each can be promoted to unlock their potentials to the fullest. Each comes with its share of lore that explains their backgrounds, abilities, and characteristics. Dozens of enemies to take on, including hidden bosses and a series of enemy compilations present in the Chessmaster Match. Crafting equipment, with unlockable recipes either from Dark Alley and every match you win against the Chessmaster.

row.name: Queen Beast
row.detailed_description: INTRODUCTION The uneventful days of the humble miller Otto are thrown into chaos one morning when he rolls out of bed to discover his beloved sister Bronwyn has been kidnapped! The culprit is a mysterious knight in black armour; the only clue left in his wake is a bag of gold coins minted with the profile of an unknown woman. Joining forces with the beautiful and enigmatic adventurer Switch, and the mischievous fairy Echo, our hero sets forth on a journey through the forgotten corners of his homeland in pursuit of the black knight and the sinister forces behind him. But on the way Otto will discover much more than he anticipated in this tale of romance, swashbuckling action, and adventure! FEATURES A concise, fully-realised visual novel inspired by genre classics 60,000 words clocking in at around 5-7 hours of reading De luxe hand-drawn character and background artwork Dozens of bespoke illustrations depicting key moments in the story A memorable original soundtrack that brings the adventure to life All for absolutely free! CHARACTERS After losing his parents to a plague, the disappearance of his older brother, and suffering an injury that left him hobbled, Otto feels as though the wheel of fortune has tossed him aside and left him to rot. When his sister, his sole remaining family, is inexplicably kidnapped, this retiring and passive youth decides he's lost quite enough and resolves to take his destiny into his own hands. From the scorching deserts of Casper comes this wily and free-spirited adventurer, hot on the trail of a series of kidnappings she's been tasked with investigating. When her path crosses with that of Otto's, the two team up in the spirit of mutual interest. But the appearance of such a stalwart ally seems almost too good to be true; just what other motivations does she harbour behind her lovely face and disarming smile? A certain incident in a magical forest thrusts the presence of this adorable, disagreeable creature into Otto and Switch's reluctant company. Living for thousands of years has granted Echo a wealth of knowledge and wisdom, but extracting anything of the sort past her dismissive and haughty personality may well prove to be an exercise in futility. Probably born to be a teacher, Otto's sister Bronwyn decided from an early age that her goal in life was to give every child in the isolated valley where the two siblings reside a proper education. Being kidnapped has thrown a considerable wrench into these plans, and being separated from her younger brother, the apple of her eye, has left the usually altruistic and patient young woman in a foul mood that she won't hesitate to visit upon her captors. A cruel and capable warlord from the harsh northern steppes. A successful military campaign has placed the land of Byron and its long-suffering people in the palm of her hand, but also left her unsatisfied, existentially bereft, and quickly sliding into indolence and hedonism. The stage is set for this slumbering beast to be roused from her stupor, but who can say whether good or ill will come of it?
row.short_description: Join Otto on his quest to rescue his sister in this fantasy visual novel.
row.notes: Contains mild coarse language, alcohol consumption, partial nudity, sexual and adult themes including references and non-explicit depictions of prostitution, assault, and off-screen sex, and occasional gore, horror, and violence.

Add your own 3D props, environments, particles, etc. Native integration with livestreaming platforms, e.g. Twitch, YouTube, Bilibili. row.name: Resonance
row.detailed_description: The story In Resonance you experience the story of the space pilot Robert Wallace and the neuroscientist Catriona Bruce. Through a chain of circumstances, these divorced spouses are chosen to explore the space station DIOMHAIR 16 in the year 2301, to which all radio contact has been lost. However, their landing is anything but smooth and so the two are confronted with bigger problems than their unprocessed separation. Terrible things have happened on board and soon it is not only survivors but also a way off the station to find. In the process, the characters not only learn the dark secrets that led to the disaster on the DIOMHAIR 16, but also get caught up in supernatural events, the resonances. In the process, they delve into their own pasts and relive formative moments of their lives together. The fate of the two and that of the entire space station is in your hands. Will you manage to repair what has been destroyed? Features Explore a science fiction drama on three timelines Learn from records what led to the sinking of the DIOMHAIR 16. Live through the resonances and decide for yourself how Robert and Catriona behaved at crucial moments in their relationship, creating your very own reality. Get to know the couple's relationship from both sides and form your own judgment. Their decisions and actions also affect the present, in which the mismatched couple make their way through the dead space station in search of an escape route. In space, only your partner can hear you scream Host your own game and invite a friend. Decide in advance which of you will take on the roles of Robert and Catriona, so two of you can experience their emotional adventure. Only by playing cooperatively will you be able to move forward and overcome the tricky challenges and tough decisions that await you at DIOMHAIR 16. The right tools for the job Find and learn how to use advanced portable tools, which you will find aboard the DIOMHAIR and integrate into your spacesuit. Move objects with the telekinetic powers of the forcetool or fight blazing flames with the fire extinguisher. Only by skillful use of the tools is there any progress. And thanks to their digital journal, you'll document every record you find and can look at it over and over again. Do you have what it takes to traverse a damaged space station? To the stars and beyond In 2301, the Interstellar Life and Military Cooperation, as a joint project of wealthy industrialists is the dominant space agency. Explore DIOMHAIR 16, which the Cooperation operated as a research station, and be prepared to discover the ethically and morally questionable experiments conducted here in the service of science. But be sure that it will not be a pretty sight. On the hands of the Cooperation and on the corridors of the station, there is the blood of those who went too far. The origins of Resonance Mittweida University of Applied Sciences has been offering the Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment degree program since 2011 and has since been training creative students in a variety of disciplines. The goals and content of this bachelor's degree program are shaped by the current professional image of modern media informatics in the Web 2.0 environment. The course of studies offers students the opportunity to educate themselves in the field of designing creative content or creating informatic applications as they wish. In the fifth semester, all media informatics students of the class of 2016 developed Resonance in a development team of 40 students over a period of almost 4 months. This final project was presented to the public at beta, the university's in-house games conference. We would like to thank our hardworking team leaders, our great project teams, our helpers, friends, family and everyone else who gave us patience, strength and trust along the way. We are proud of Resonance and hope you have fun playing it.
row.short_description: Deep dive into space and explore the story of Robert and Catriona. You will discover the catastrophic events that happened on the station and get to know mysterious RESONANCES while being confronted with a tragic past.
row.notes: In this game you will encounter murdered people, drug abuse and suggestions of suicide and depression.

You've just landed the role of a lifetime: owner of a hotel that's seen better days. It's like stepping into a 1950s adventure movie – the previous owner's mysterious end, a hotel riddled with secrets, and now, it's all yours. Your quest: to transform this relic into a beacon of style and history. Choose from a range of furnishings that span decades, each with its own story to tell. But it's not just about the décor. row.name: SquadBlast
row.detailed_description: The year is 2042 and the state of the planet has been in decline: bankrupt governments and ruthless dictators are plentiful, while selfish corporations rule the world. Injustice against the powerless population is rampant. But there is hope. Armed gangs organized by a shadowy organization are intent on battling the oppressive evil. SquadBlast is a free-to-play multiplayer run and gun shooter. Its team-based battles are an innovative take on a shooter that you have to experience — meticulously balanced for fairness and incredibly easy to pick up and play. In SquadBlast, every bullet matters. You'll need to adapt diverse lines of attack to claim victory in a variety of modes. Play cross-platform with your friends for free on Xbox Series S|X, Xbox One, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android, web, cloud and PC with full controller support. DEEP CLASS-BASED COMBAT Choose from a roster of heroes, each with their own abilities, to turn the tide of battle in your team’s favor. You’re sure to find a favorite, but you’ll have to master them all – and even swap heroes mid-battle – to shut down your opponents’ dreams of victory! AN FPS IN DISGUISE Bring all your skills from your favorite FPS. Swap to your secondary after unloading with your main. Equip your melee weapon to run unburdened. Rocketjump for a greater vertical leap. Slide down ramps, bunny hop, vault over projectiles and more. MEATY MULTIPLAYER Jump into battle to master each essential multiplayer mode, from TDM to Capture the Point to Payload. Better yet, pick a custom match to choose the map, mode, and rules that suit you best. Always expect a smooth experience since all the action is synced with perfect rollback netcode. Lead your squad to striking locations across the troubled world of 2042. GUNS GALORE One thing's for sure – there are tons of guns in SquadBlast, from assault rifles to rocket launchers to experimental supa weapons. Get your hands on each one and get a feel for the play style that maximizes its effectiveness. SUPER COMFY CONTROLS Pick up and play! All the controls are right where you'd expect them to be whether you're playing with a controller or mouse and keyboard.
row.short_description: Master the most intense platformer shooter ever created. Play in teams of up to 5v5 players across 8 game modes or make your own custom lobby. Collect & craft an arsenal of weapons to master your loadout. Play cross-platform for free on PC, Console, Mobile, and Web with full controller support.
row.reviews: “It’s got the spirit of Overwatch and CS:GO, but all excitingly represented on a 2D plane.” VG247 “SquadBlast: 2D Overwatch meets Quake — and it’s really good” Dexerto “The secret lovechild of Metal Slug and Super Smash Bros.” GameSpew

row.name: Rawbots
row.detailed_description: A universe where you can play with amazing robots that are designed, built and even programmed by you. Everything is a robot, doors, roads, walls, bridges, safes, traps, turrets, surveillance systems, etc. Build forts, towers and architect impressive structures to protect your planets and resources. You may play solo or with friends to infiltrate, conquer planets and gather resources. The Rawbots universe has a unique set of matter, energy and physics laws. These laws are engineered to serve up fun emergent gameplay that is different every time you play. Everything you would expect from a sandbox game and more. We are taking this to the next level with gameplay that truly emerges beyond imagination and defined contextually by the type of robots you build. On one planet you might experience a first person shooting experience, go into a space battle in 3rd person, and down into an RTS offensive on another planet. An intuitive and streamlined graph system will bestow the power of visual programming into the hands of creative minds. Under the hood, the latest in signal processing, inverse kinematics and PID controllers, will breathe life into your creations. From geeks, to tinkers, to grinders, there is a creation path for everyone. And while you are building and tinkering around, we will also be busy developing story campaigns, random missions, battle tournaments and creating new and impressive bot parts.

row.name: 航海霸業 Maritime hegemony
row.detailed_description: Steam group: Official qq group: 292234923 Official qq No.: 211206417 Game background: From the 15th century to the 17th century AD, extensive transoceanic activities and major breakthroughs in geography were initiated around the world, especially in Europe. These ocean-going activities facilitated communication between the continents of the planet and, with it, numerous new trade routes. With the opening of new air routes, cultural and trade exchanges between the East and the West increased greatly, and Europe developed rapidly during this period and laid the foundation for prosperity over Asia. In this era, people not only discovered new continents and gained a lot of geographic knowledge, but also greatly promoted European overseas trade. The new shipping routes also had a long-lasting impact on the development of the world's continents hundreds of years later. Players play as the owner of a fleet in the game, earn silver coins and prestige through trade, obtain crafting materials for various ships through battles, and then continuously upgrade their ships into better ships. Equip yourself with a variety of gear and recruit legendary captains to boost your power. The game faithfully restores the magnificent era of navigation. The map covers the entire waters of Western Europe, Northern Europe, the Mediterranean and North Africa. The unique cities in that era, the distinctive specialties, and the local customs full of rich and exotic customs are displayed through this game. to the majority of players Authentic and regionally specific trade items The goods in the game 'Navigation Domination' all reflect the faithful restoration of Europe in the 16th century. In the Mediterranean Sea, the North Sea, and the Baltic Sea coast, there are many ports with developed shipping and trade. These ports produce goods with unique regional characteristics. Some commodities are bought at low prices from the origin, and then shipped to the other side of the sea to be sold, and experience the specialties and customs from all over the world. The original stock trading system, changing rapidly In the game, the price of all goods is determined by the player's behavior. If many players buy the same goods, the price of the goods will soar. The price of goods is refreshed every 30 seconds, and the ever-changing excitement will make you greatly stimulated in the game. Rich social relationships, criss-crossing, emotional sublimation The game has a rich social relationship system, such as friends, enemies, alliances, etc. A true restoration of the historical era After the Renaissance, due to the great geographical discoveries, wealth stimulated the prosperity of commerce and the advancement of technology, which made transoceanic trade that had never been possible before, and thus, an era of great voyages came. In the game 'Navigation Domination', the art style faithfully restores the historical features of the era of great sailing. You can see various buildings filled with Mediterranean style in the game, and you can also see the famous sailing ships that once traversed the four seas, and that A navigator with vivid names. The sense of substitution of the game is very strong. Through your growth step by step, you will change from a nameless sailor to a great navigator with footsteps all over the four oceans.
row.short_description: 'Navigation Domination' is an RPG game with the 15th century era of great voyage as the background. Based on the 14th to 19th centuries, especially the world after the great geographical discovery and the opening of new routes, maps, ports, cities and specialties for trade are constructed.

row.name: Dodge Mania
row.detailed_description: Dodge Mania is a simple game made by Unity. You will control different charracters in different levels and your goal is to dodge objects falling to you. This game will test your reactions , dodging ability and quick thinking. while first two levels are just about dodging nexrt levels have mechanics such as collecting potions or flying enemy chasing you.
row.short_description: In Dodge Mania you will go through different levels where you will control character and you have to dodge falling objects. New level - new custom objects!!

row.name: Jasper and the City of Lights
row.detailed_description: Roadmap Join the journey into the world of cozy adventure gaming! The Weasel Club is the perfect place for those who love games about exploring mystical worlds, cultures and heartwarming stories. We are building the Weasel Club as a hub for players to get involved with the direction of projects like Jasper, and for developers to be part of a friendly and supportive group that values creativity and thoughtfulness. Some key features of the Weasel Club include: Beta-access to games Giveaways Events like game-jams or screenshot contests We can't wait to see you there! <3 About the Game On summer vacation Jasper and Nora were separated, when one of them carelessly decided to enter the forbidden forest in front of their grandparents farm all alone. Jasper, Nora's young brother, gathers courage when he sees a star falling out of the night sky and takes on the quest to find and bring back his beloved sister and reunite the family. Features Survive the Cold! Something is going on in the depth of the old forest in front of grandma Sophies farm: Snow and ice, in the middle of summer? Don't venture too deep into the icy cold of the whispering forest or you will join the freezing souls of Myr! Bring the World to Life! A shooting star crashes inside the very forest where Jasper's big sister is thought to be missing. Where will it guide Jasper? Light up candles and lanterns and experience the forest coming back to life! Complete your Collection! Document the mystical nature of the forest and its inhabitants and present your findings at the Library of Myr. Find Nora’s treasures and other collectables and showcase them back at the Narrator’s home. Collect Soul Dust to strengthen Jasper's fallen star and increase your power! Make Friends! At first glance only the whispering masks live within the shadows of the woods. But wait, is that light in the distance? The deeper you go, the more you will learn about a civilization that only a few people ever got to tell stories about. Reveal the Mystery! Ice and snow in the middle of the summer. The stars are falling out of the sky. Whispering masks lurk in the shadows. The lights of a city on the horizon. And a name that makes the people of Myr shudder: Svangur Stay Warm <3 Many cozy features are coming to Jasper. This is a game that can be explored in your own pace. We do try to invite you to stay for a while and enjoy the atmosphere. Wholesome features that are planned for the future include: Jasper’s analog camera A library that you can upgrade and fill with knowledge Fishing (Soul flower gardening?) (Just sitting down near a warm candle and taking a break from the long journey?) ??? About We started working on Jasper with a vision of what we would love to play, today we are proud and happy about what we created. After we worked so long on Jasper, it's sometimes hard for us to keep focus on what matters. For us this is not just a game we love to play anymore but a passion project that we poured our heart into and at this point we constantly get lost in little details. So for the next step we are moving to a community-driven approach. We need to continue work on this openly and with your  opinions, wishes and criticism! If you are into games that are fully about immersing yourself into mystical worlds, cultures and heartwarming stories, please join us on this journey. Jasper is our framework to build a world about love, kindness and slowing down. Join us on the Weasel Club Discord to discuss with us about the City of Myr that is hidden within the Whispering Forest.
row.short_description: A cozy adventure about love, kindness and slowing down. Two siblings are separated, a mystical forest is where they were last seen. In the darkest shadows, an old spirit is hiding, but the lights of an ancient city is shining between the branches. Fully narrated, easy to play.

row.name: Hansel And Gretel
row.detailed_description: Play as Hansel And Gretel in a puzzle-adventure game based on the fairy tale by the brothers Grimm. Key Features: - Play Single-player or Local Multiplayer. - Unique puzzles. - Classic-Inspired Pixel Graphics. - More than 40 types of items. - Hidden Secrets & Magical creatures. - Enjoy beautiful soundtracks. - The game is about 1 hour long.
row.short_description: A Fantasy Puzzle-Adventure game, Based on the fairytale 'Hansel and Gretel'. Play as both Hansel & Gretel, Solve puzzles, Collect items, Meet magical creatures and live happily ever after!

row.name: The One Penny Adventure
row.detailed_description: You start the game with one penny, you have to find the person who is interested in trading your penny for anything more valuable then the penny for example a Pen, then sell the pen for a Coin, then buy a water bottle with that and sell it double the price, continue the cycle until you have enough money to afford the plane ticket to the next city, You also have side quests like walking the Dog, collecting plastic trash and selling it, finding golf balls and starting a bid and food deliveries, Once you buy or rent any of the vehicle, You start getting food delivery orders. Use all the money to buy the plan tickets and reach to the mrBest and deliver him the penny but don't waste your time since you only have 30 days, and remember to feed Trayan every day. Good Luck :)
row.short_description: Cross Aremica with only one penny and deliver the penny to mrBest. You have one penny and have to trade it for bigger and better items until you sell your last item and have enough money to buy a plane ticket to the next city, You have to cross 5 cities in order to deliver mrBest the penny.

row.name: Another World Quest
row.detailed_description: Build Your Deck At the beginning of the game you need to choose one of the three camps to build a powerful deck (a deck must be full of 30 cards before it can be used). The three camps represent three different ideas of card sets, three leaders, and three different traverser paths. Players can freely choose to use cards from the camps or neutral cards depending on the effects of the cards. 【Wolfraid Clan】A fast attack deck consisting of a large number of cheap, high-quality creatures and spells that deal direct damage. 【Church of the Holy Blood】A midrange deck that focuses on strengthening the attack and defense of quality creatures, specializing in group enhancement spells. 【Aurora Fleet】 A fast summoning high cost creatures through creature acceleration or spell acceleration. The remaining four camps will be unlocked as the plot progresses. Enhance and fight Each time you get a victory you get gold and pieces. Gold can be used to buy supplement packs in the store to enhance your deck. Shards can be used to generate the cards you need directly, or you can get shards by destroying cards you don't need. Even if you fail, you can still get a lot of Coin. Try to build a powerful deck! Tales from the traveler The continent of Fran is a land of perennial comet falls. These comets bring powerful magical power to enhance the monster, resulting in the human living in this land suffered the end of the disaster. At the same time, the comet also has the energy to open the portal. Many travellers were thus transported to this other world. Of course, the portal can not only transport travellers, but also transport those other world's frightening monster ...... As a traveler, you will choose to lead the people back to the original world? Or stay and build the other world? ...... or use the power of the comet to rule the world?
row.short_description: The painting run group project derived card game 'AnotherWorldQuest'.It tells the story of a group of travellers to the other world and in the face of disaster.The game itself is similar to 'Hearthstone' kind of card game, has a complete battle, collection, card draw function, etc..

row.name: Disfigure
row.detailed_description: Disfigure is entirely free to play for the time being, so please consider supporting us through the donation DLC! Gameplay In an arena shrouded in darkness, pay close attention to your surroundings—monsters could be lurking anywhere. Swap between Circle and Cone Vision modes: one lets you see around but not far, while the other lets you see far in one direction. Fight escalating horrors, level up, and survive! Build Variety Choose from over 200 upgrades and 100+ weapon perks to create limitless build possibilities. Shoot lightning, fire thousands of bullets—every upgrade tree changes the way you play. Control your vision sources: will you sacrifice visibility for strength, or harness light to destroy your enemies? Variety of Weapons Unlock new weapons with currency earned from runs! Each weapon behaves differently and has its own unique perks allowing for a multitude of different builds. Content 2 Maps each featuring 20+ enemies and minibosses, plus 5 bosses—each with unique attack patterns (3rd Map Coming Soon!) Over 200 unique upgrades to choose from 15+ weapons each with unique perks Quick restarts with 20-30 minute runs that can also be played endlessly 4 difficulty modes Online leaderboards
row.short_description: Disfigure is a grim-dark rogue-like where you battle relentless hordes of monsters lurking in the shadows. Unlock powerful weapons, craft god-like builds with hundreds of upgrades, slay colossal bosses, and push your limits in intense 20–30 minute survival runs.

row.name: RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure! ~SHOBOMI AND THE PHANTOM RUINS~
row.detailed_description: New DLC Available About the Game Action game suitable for live game play and streaming, which looks cute but full of unreasonable traps! 「RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!」 'RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!' series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal! The second in the series! Join the 'Shobomi Expedition' and explore the phantom ruins full of traps! Unpredictable traps everywhere! A lot of unpredictable traps that will make you shout, 'How is this possible!!?' were prepared. For example, when you try to pick up a coin, you are trapped in iron bars, and when you are stuck, spikes fall on you, or when you pick up a key, you are crushed because you cannot bear the weight of the key. The game is full of traps that you cannot even imagine. We assume that the main target players are live game players and streamers. As a secondary target, we are targeting players who like to play 2D platformers with high difficulty level. We want the game to be delivered and played live, and for the audience to get excited by enjoying the reactions of the distributors. In addition, we hope that the distributors and the audience will cooperate with each other to find solutions by communicating and thinking of ways to avoid the traps together.
row.short_description: Action game suitable for live game play and streaming, which looks cute but full of unreasonable traps! 'RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!' series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal!

row.name: Heartbite: Dating in Daylight
row.detailed_description: You wake up early, and the sun is already beginning to shed its rays over the skies. But this time you won’t hide away from sunlight. Food’s out after all, and who knows what (or who) you’ll encounter out there? Maybe there is hope for a nocturnal creature such as yourself to find what you’ve been looking for? Get to know a unique cast of characters as you go through your day in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim! These mini games are a platformer, a physics playground and an old school RPG battle!
row.short_description: Get to know a unique cast of characters in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim!
row.notes: Sexual descriptions and jokes, No sexual graphics.
