row.detailed_description: Not enough friends to play? Join our LFG Discord group! Brawl it out in a Super Casual Ultimate Fight Fest (Extra Deluxe) [SCUFFED], where up to 6 players can fight for the top by customizing their loadouts with more than 20 skill-altering passives! The player with the most points at the end of 6 rounds wins! Features Up to 6 players online 4 different classes Various game changing passives 3 different Arenas Choose from 4 unique classes, each fitted with 2 skills. Customize abilities after each round. Pick from a variety of passives as well as one game altering passive every game!! And a big thank you to these awesome people that helped us playtest the game Cavan Low Nabilah Nazmi Calvin Seah Samuel Chen Quek Ming Kang Soh Rui Ming Shaun Ng Aaron Chu Ashraf Azhar Tan Cheng Ying Aqil Hilmi Ho Heng Wan Justin Simon Maximilian Gay Tan Yun Yang Louis Choo Koh Jia Ming Ivan Ho Joseph Cheng Tan Heng Chee Lee Wei Da Dave Kang Samuel Soh Amir Janus Gohan Terence Oh Jun Yang Jeryl goh Darren Tey Jasper Lim Yeo Chong Ye Jonathan Yap Nathaniel Chong Wei Xiang Keith Goh Samuel Lum
row.short_description: Choose from 4 different classes and various passive combinations to fight it out and compete for glory! Super Casual Ultimate Fight Fest (Extra Deluxe) is a free to play up-to-6-players online arena brawler that pits you and 5 other players in rapid 6-rounds games!

row.name: Maze Of The Gamja
row.detailed_description: About This Game Solve Gamja-puzzles and Acquire Gamja-knowledges! Maze Of The Gamja is a puzzle game that can be played with a keyboard or mouse. Move up, down, left, right, or activate the surrounding blocks to open a new path. Each action will reduce the count and all sweet potatoes must be obtained before the count reaches zero. There are 66 Gamja-puzzles, 193 Gamja-photos, and 75 Gamja-knowledge!
row.short_description: Solve Gamja-puzzles and Acquire Gamja-knowledges! Maze Of The Gamja is a free liner puzzle game with Gamja. Move or active your Gamja and get sweet potatos. 66 stages, 193 photos and 75 Gamja-knowledge are waiting for you.

row.name: Capitals
row.detailed_description: A mash-up of the common idle clicker genre and a city builder, Capitals is a fast-paced and competitive strategy game. Each match is set on a resizable game board made up of hexagonal tiles, randomly generated each time you play. Games will have you try to build and grow your city as fast as possible, forcing you to keep up with the ai or players you're up against. There are two ways to win: spread your territory as far across the map as possible, building over enough 'winning tiles' to collect the majority out of all other players; or play the offense/defense game and wipe out your competition. But if you aren't playing a balance of both you're bound to lose. This game is a year-long labor of love accompanied by a thorough soundtrack from a project partner, so I hope this delivers! If you'd like to learn more about the both of us the developer credits include links and are on the first page upon opening the game...
row.short_description: A mash-up of the common idle clicker genre and a city builder, Capitals is a fast-paced and competitive strategy game. Each match is set on a resizable game board made up of hexagonal tiles, randomly generated each time you play.

row.name: Trimurti Online
row.detailed_description: Discover and explore the world of Trimurti Online! Enjoy a classic MMO experience with your friends, meet people from all over the world, share objectives and face countless challenges in the world of Trimurti Online. Long argument. Solo and group missions. Boss hunt. Raids. Dungeons. Guild wars. Free and ranked PvP arenas. Duels/PK Mode. Crafting, collecting, life skills. Choose one of 8 fully customizable characters and select the play style that best suits you. Manipulate the stats and skill tree as you wish! Fully customizable appearance. Weapons and armor that change the appearance of your character. Wide collection of accessories and cosmetic items. Statistics freely manipulated by assigning spirit points. 8 different specializations to choose from. Flexible skill tree that allows for mixed specializations. FREE TO PLAY Trimurti Online offers a true Free to Play experience , a game without Item Mall or Cash Shop. Experience a classic, fair MMORPG where your character's growth is rewarded for your efforts!
row.short_description: Relive the classic gameplay of an old-school MMORPG. Select a class that suits your style and join your friends to explore the vast world of Trimurti Online. Upgrade your equipment and maximize your skills, face monsters and bosses, conquer dungeons.

row.name: Unsolved Case
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT : 'Unsolved Case' is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac . Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community - find the link in the game details on the right! CRACK THE UNSOLVED CASE Unsolved Case is the free, standalone prequel to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Dip your toes in and go back to where it all began as you team up as detective duo Old Dog and Ally against the Cryptic Killer. For the first time in the series, you'll encounter a labyrinth of puzzles and challenges laid by one of the most devious minds in the world. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and find a way out. Do you have what it takes to crack the Unsolved Case of the Cryptic Killer? Crack the case during a focused playthrough of 30-60 minutes—perfect for a night of puzzle solving. THE STORY SO FAR Years ago, the twisted Cryptic Killer was put away behind bars at the infamous Anagram Asylum. But today, he's back, and he's taunting the detectives. Did they catch the wrong guy, or are they looking at a copycat killer? A new lead arrives in the form of a mysterious locked box, delivered directly to their addresses. Detectives Ally and Old Dog are once again sent on a chase that'll challenge them unlike any case before. Explore new locations, crack codes, and unravel the mystery. In this prequel, you're invited to step into the detectives' shoes and return to where it all began. THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER Two minds are better than one, and the only way you'll be able to crack the Cryptic Killer's codes is by working together. Through separate screens, you and your friend will each be given half of a puzzle at each location. Communicate, collaborate, and work together to push your puzzle-solving skills to the limit. FEATURES LIST Full Game for Free Get started as detectives Ally and Old Dog with this complete prequel game at no cost, providing a glimpse into the larger puzzle series. 30-60 Minutes of Puzzle Solving Immerse yourself in an adventure filled with engaging puzzles, designed to be resolved within half an hour to an hour. Two Player Co-Op In Unsolved Case, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner and will be tested on your communication! Challenging Collaborative Puzzles Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes. Explore Illustrated World Unsolved Case's hand-illustrated environments are inspired by noir novels. Draw on… Everything! You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment. Hurry up, or risk losing more than just the case!
row.short_description: A new lead turns up old doubts about an 'Unsolved Case'. A trap, or a copycat killer? In this co-op puzzle game prequel to the award-winning Cryptic Killer series, put on your detective badges as you collaborate and communicate to crack the codes, solve the riddles, and catch the Cryptic Killer.

row.name: Desktop Jumpscares
row.detailed_description: Desktop Jumpscares makes your entire PC a horror game, it's a game-overlay that jumpscares you randomly meaning you'll constantly be anticipating your demise. You can use custom images/gifs and custom sounds Some extra fun features: You can change how randomly and often you'll be jumpscared Fun to use alongside other games, or just to wake yourself up👍
row.short_description: Desktop Jumpscares is a game-overlay that scares you with crAaAaAzzzy jumpscares anywhere on the go. You can customize sounds, frequency, images, and some other fun options to guarantee you crap your pants

row.name: Layer Hunt
row.detailed_description: Layer Hunt is a survival sandbox and dungeon game where the goal is to survive and hunt down all the bosses. To reach your goal you will have to mine, craft, build, farm, fight and explore for new abilities and resources. The world is broken up through many different layers that each offer new enemies, minerals and dungeons to explore. To progress, the player must explore all these layers and eliminate each layer's boss to finally beat the game. Layer based dungeon system - Explore underground layers to hunt down bosses and enemies in their fortified dungeons. Defeat the boss to unlock the next layer where you will find new resources and more difficult challenges. Combat - Craft your own weapons and spells with the resources you found. Learn new abilities called Knowledges which you may find scattered across the world in enemy camps. Survival sandbox - Search the underground layers to gather ores, abilities and magic orbs for spellcrafting for better survival. Or travel the different biomes to gather wood, food or other resources to build yourself a base for protection. Procedural generation - Explore a procedural generated world for a new experience every time you play Building and farming - Build your own house to secure a safe space for your resources and farms. Craft new furniture or use your obtained treasures to decorate your house, and of course build a railway system to connect to your friends' houses to show it off! Multiplayer - Play with your friends in a maximum group of 8 More layers - More underground layers with unique monsters and bosses Overworld - Additional content on the different biomes Items - New items and abilities Building - More variation in building And more...
row.short_description: Layer Hunt is a singleplayer, survival sandbox game where the goal is to survive and hunt down all the bosses. To reach your goal you will have to mine, craft, build, farm, fight and explore for new abilities and resources.

row.name: VChat
row.detailed_description: Basic Introduction Gmail email registration is not supported for the time being. Gmail email registration is not supported for the time being. P.S. There are quite a number of problems, sometimes it's a bit wacky, and there are also bugs. It's a free product, mainly for fun, so please don't be too critical. Before 0:00 on January 1st, 2025, the first 3, middle 3, and last 3 comments of each person will be eligible to receive 150 yuan of game shopping funds! It's a voice social software for two-dimensional virtual avatars based on the capture of a single camera. After entering the application, users can set up their own two-dimensional virtual avatars. Subsequently, they can conduct voice chats by matching with other users. During the video chat process, they will use their own two-dimensional virtual avatars. The application will project users' expressions and movements onto the two-dimensional virtual characters through facial recognition technology, thus enabling voice chat socialization. Users can manipulate the expressions of virtual characters through their own expressions. Briefly speaking, it's similar to the Avatar system. In the movie 'Avatar', real bodies are manipulated, while players can manipulate two-dimensional virtual avatars through this application. It will continue to be developed in the future, and functions such as users' custom uploading of network models will be added. It also supports the individual anchor mode, the online social mode, and the desktop companion mode. It supports full-body and half-body motion capture. Desktop Companion Mode You can chat with your friends while playing games, studying. Normal Matching Mode VRM It supports uploading custom VRM models. (Only pre-made model matching is supported.) Live2D
row.short_description: I wanted to have a secondary voice social space that could be used for motion capture with just a normal webcam and only a low configuration computer. So VChat was born, and it supports both single-user virtual host mode and virtual image voice chatting and dating using network matching mode.

row.name: All Hallows Evie
row.detailed_description: It's the day before Halloween, and Spooktoids have only gone and stolen all the candy buckets from around town. They have made off with them into their underground, sometimes over-ground (never wombling free) caverns and intend to hoard them for themselves, ruining Halloween in the process! Not on Evie's watch! Evie chased the Spooktoids down and located the entrance to their lair! Now she must navigate the caverns and collect all the candy buckets so the good folks of the town have candy to dish out on Halloween! This is very much an 80's inspired retro game! You must collect all the items on each screen to open the exit and progress to the next. You must jump gaps, climb ladders, avoid nasties and not touch anything pointy! Should you fall into a trap or hit a Spooktoid, you will lose a life and restart the screen! This is a very difficult little game but not unfair! Learn the baddie paths and practice any level you get stuck on with the handy practice mode, once you have reached that level of course!
row.short_description: All Hallows Evie is a Halloween themed single screen style platform game moulded on the 8 bit classics of the ZX Spectrum. This is a difficult game! Please keep that in mind going in..

row.name: Mysterious School
row.detailed_description: [Background Story] In this town lies an abandoned school that has been deserted for years, after a tragic incident that occurred there. A beautiful young girl committed suicide inside the school, leaving many people deeply saddened by the news. However, strange occurrences started to happen in the school after that. Every night at midnight, an identical girl to the one who had committed suicide would appear in the school cafeteria. She would sit there for an hour before disappearing, leaving the same message every time: 'I want to go home.' Even more mysterious, people would sometimes catch a glimpse of her in various corners of the school, only to have her disappear in the blink of an eye. Many students and teachers were afraid of these occurrences and didn't dare venture out at night. Some believe that this is the girl's soul searching for the way home, seeking help rather than threatening anyone. Regardless, everyone in the school hopes that her soul can find its way home and rest in peace. [Gameplay] In this horror game, you need to work together with your team to find and destroy the evil items that manipulate the girl, in order to rescue her soul. Of course, if you are brave enough, you can also complete this task alone. The girl won't always be chasing you; her appearance is governed by different rules. There are five different talismans in the game, each with its own power. You need to observe the situation at all times because the rules change in different stages. Once you break the rules, you will be in big trouble. The game not only includes the task of breaking the curse, but you can also find other interesting things around the campus. You can go to the basketball court to shoot some hoops, or use the basketball to scare the chickens. There's also a storage room that seems to contain some fireworks. See if you can find it and have a fireworks party with your friends in the schoolyard. [Game Features] Fun hide-and-seek gameplay Players need to be aware of the changing rules and avoid traps set by their teammates, using different strategies and plans to evade the pursuit of evil ghosts. Besides hiding, players can also use the environment to cover themselves, increasing their chances of survival. Random paranormal events Random and creepy paranormal events can occur in the game, such as encountering a funeral procession in a dark hallway, experiencing eerie illusions in the infirmary, or being trapped in a locked room, increasing the excitement of the game. Huge map The game map includes a complete school environment, including various classrooms, laboratories, infirmaries, offices, cafeterias, dormitories, security rooms, and basketball courts, allowing players to experience the game in a realistic setting. Multiplayer experience The game can be played by multiple people simultaneously, with players able to form teams to solve puzzles or play independently and freely explore the entire school. Rich storyline The background story of the game is captivating, with the main characters needing to unravel the story behind it and uncover clues to break the curse.
row.short_description: 'Mysterious School' is a horror game that supports multi player online and single player. Why do girls often cry on campus at midnight? What happened to the once famous No.1 middle school? Take your partner, find out the truth that the young girl has become a zombie, and help the girl reincarnate.

row.name: Etheria: Restart
row.detailed_description: Etheria is an Ethereal Hero RPG When a devastating global freeze threatens to extinguish human civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into 'Etheria,' a virtual world, to preserve their legacy. Within Etheria, humans coexist with beings known as the Animus, who wield mysterious Anima Powers. Their peaceful coexistence shatters when the 'Genesis Virus' emerges, corrupting the Animus and driving them berserk, endangering humanity's survival. In response, the Hyperlinker Union forms to combat this threat. Take on the role of a Hyperlinker and begin your adventure in Etheria. [Breathtaking 3D Visuals & Cinematic Spectacle] Built in Unreal Engine, Etheria delivers cinematic immersion through lifelike lighting, detailed shadows, and fully rendered real-time scenes. Each character features unique combat animations enhanced by dynamic camera work and dazzling effects, creating spectacular battles without visual clutter or overwhelming effects. [Strategic Combat & Limitless Team Compositions] Etheria evolves classic turn-based combat by incorporating diverse strategic mechanics and sandbox exploration, delivering a next-generation Team RPG experience! Create countless team combinations by synergizing Animus abilities, issue real-time combat commands, and freely control each Animus in battle. Master skill combinations and tactical setups to experience the thrill of overcoming powerful foes through superior strategy. [Strategic PvP Arena Battles] Step into the Arena, where non-stop duels rage day and night! Engage in exhilarating PvP battles amid roaring crowds, showcase your unique strategies to fellow Hyperlinkers, and experience the pure thrill of tactical competition as you pursue your combat dreams! [Venture into the Threshold] Explore Etheria's rich PvE content, where formidable foes from the Main Quest return in the Threshold, GP Outposts, and Investigations. Team up with your Animus squad to tackle powerful bosses! For those seeking greater challenges, venture into the Ember ruins, where even deadlier and more mysterious adversaries await... [Forge Your Combat Style] Each Animus features a unique Prowess system with diverse progression paths. Customize their abilities through Shell equipment and nearly a hundred different Ether Module combinations to develop distinct fighting styles and combat approaches. Create specialized builds for your favorite Animus to tackle any battle scenario! row.name: Cracking the Cryptic
row.detailed_description: Line Sudoku Line Sudoku is a pack devoted to sudokus involving… LINES! Each puzzle features one or more of the popular “lines constraints” that often feature in variant puzzles on Cracking The Cryptic, including Renban, German Whispers, Palindromes, Region Sum and Ten Lines! We’re thrilled that Line Sudoku includes puzzles by Phistomefel, Qodec, Clover, zetamath, Jay Dyer, Tallcat, Mr Menace, Peter Veenis, Joseph Nehme, Richard Stolk, Prasanna Seshadri, Tyrgannus and Full Deck & Missing A Few Cards! In addition, Mark and Simon have written hints for the challenging puzzles themselves so these hints are meaningful and, above all, educational. -------------------- Welcome to the brand new Sudoku app from YouTube’s most popular Sudoku channel, Cracking The Cryptic. Unlike other Sudoku apps, we feature handcrafted and curated puzzles from the world’s best Sudoku constructors. Each collection features puzzles made by various authors that are now familiar names to those who follow the channel. Authors like Phistomefel, Clover, Sam Cappleman-Lynes, Christoph Seeliger, Richard Stolk, jovi_al, Qodec, Prasanna Seshadri and of course, Simon and Mark! Downloading Cracking the Cryptic will give you access to our two launch packs. Our first free collection is a variety pack by Prasanna Seshadri featuring 7 puzzles inspired from our previous Sudoku apps; Sandwich, Classic, Chess, Thermo, Miracle, Killer and Arrow Sudoku. Our first paid collection is Domino Sudoku, a new variant not featured in our previous apps with puzzles from our amazing constructors. We’ll be releasing more free and paid packs in the future so keep an eye on the app for more Sudoku content from Cracking The Cryptic! -------------------- Domino Sudoku Domino Sudoku is named after its domino-like appearance with X's, V's, white dots and black dots placed between cells on the grid. Each puzzle features one or more of these domino types with them all having a different effect: an X means digits in the two cells in the domino must sum to 10; a V means they sum to 5; a white dot means the digits are consecutive; and, finally, a black dot means the digits must be in a 1:2 ratio (ie one of the digits must be double the other). As you can imagine, when you allow the world’s best Sudoku makers to use these rules they are in their element and they’ve made another set of masterpieces for this collection with a huge amount of variety! We’re thrilled that Domino Sudoku includes puzzles by Christoph Seeliger, Sam Cappleman-Lynes, Richard Stolk, Prasanna Seshadri, Phistomefel, Qodec, Clover and jovi_al. In addition, Mark and Simon have written hints for the challenging puzzles themselves so these hints are meaningful and, above all, educational. As a bonus, Studio Goya has curated 10 generated beginner puzzles so that players of all skill levels can enjoy Domino Sudoku! In Cracking The Cryptic’s games, players start with zero stars and earn stars by solving puzzles. The more puzzles you solve, the more stars you earn and the more puzzles you get to play. Only the most dedicated (and cleverest) sudoku players will finish all the puzzles. Of course the difficulty is carefully calibrated to ensure lots of puzzles at every level (from easy through to extreme). So do join us as we continue to try to revolutionize Sudoku app genre.
row.short_description: Curated Sudoku puzzles from YouTube's most popular Sudoku channel, Cracking the Cryptic!

row.name: Firefly Studio
row.detailed_description: Firefly Studio is a Virtual YouTuber software. In addition to supporting 2D/3D model import and facial capture, the software provides aesthetically pleasing and powerful 3D scenes for users to utilize. Within the 3D scenes, various operations such as lighting control and screen control can be performed, enhancing the realism of your virtual image. Additionally, the software offers 3D scene editing functionality, allowing users to create unique and personalized 3D environments for their virtual avatars. What can the software do? - Model Import: The software supports the import of 2D/3D models, allowing users to choose virtual avatars that suit their preferences. - Facial Capture: The software features facial capture functionality, enabling real-time capture of users' facial expressions and movements through a USB camera or iOS device. These captured expressions and movements can then be applied to the virtual avatar, making it more lively and realistic. - Model Actions & Expressions: Users can control the actions and expressions of their virtual avatars, mimicking human movements such as blinking, smiling, and nodding, thereby increasing interactivity with the audience. - 3D Scene Control: Within the software's 3D scenes, users can perform various operations such as lighting control and screen control to enhance the realism of the virtual avatar's environment. - 3D Scene Editing: The software provides 3D scene editing functionality, allowing users to customize and design unique 3D environments that seamlessly blend with their virtual avatars. - Virtual Camera: The software supports virtual camera functionality, allowing users to directly apply their virtual avatars to real-time communication software, game streaming platforms, and more, enabling real-time interaction with the audience. - Customizable Hotkeys: The software allows users to customize hotkeys, facilitating quick adjustments and switches between various functions and settings, improving user convenience and efficiency. Contact Us: If you encounter any issues or have any ideas while using the software, you can join our QQ group (Group ID: 672728738) to communicate with other users. We are more than happy to answer your questions and welcome your feedback and suggestions.

In the 3D scene, operations such as lighting control, screen control, etc. can be performed to make your virtual image more realistic.

row.name: The In Between
row.detailed_description: Overview The In Between is an online multiplayer game where you play as a hunter or a demon. The goal is simple: eliminate the other team! Hunter Gameplay Hunters can cast two spells: attack and protect. To power these spells, hunters must gather charges that are scattered throughout the map. The attack spell requires full charge, while the protect spell only requires some charge and lasts longer the more charge that you have. When protected, attack spells do not affect the hunter. Attack spells can result in four different outcomes: If another hunter is nearby and protected, nothing happens. If another hunter is nearby and possessed, the demon dies. Otherwise, if another hunter is nearby, they die. If no other hunter is nearby, the caster dies. As a hunter, you must be careful with your attack spell. Luckily, candles indicate when a hunter has been possessed and when a demon is nearby. Use them to your advantage! Demon Gameplay Demons can possess hunters. When possessing a hunter, a demon can use the hunter's spells. When used by a demon, the attack spell results in similar outcomes. The only difference is that if no other hunter is nearby and the demon casts the attack spell, the demon dies, not the host hunter. To gain more possession time, demons must gather charges, just like hunters do. The only way a demon can kill a hunter is to possess another hunter and use the attack spell.
row.short_description: A competitive party game that pits demons against spell-casting hunters! A demon must possess a hunter to attack other hunters, and a hunter must successfully attack a possessed hunter to defeat the demon. But both sides must be careful to not attack members of their own team.

Hire bakers, cashiers and managers to run your bakery and let it run idle while you are offline making you coins and gems while are you away and become a true tycoon of the baking world. Features: Over 150 cute desserts to collect Periodic Events year round Daily Challenges Over 100 Awards to collect Prestige / Ascension System. Managers that earn you in game cash while you are away (Offline). Inventory System with Display Cases No Internet connection requirement Different Franchise with unique recipes to unlock Skill Tree system Portrait / TATE Support Idle Baker Boss is great for casual gamers and fans of idle clicker games and appeals to those who like to maximize efficiency and profits. Bake your way to the top of the industry. If you love to see numbers go up (NGU), are a fan of idle games or incremental games and cute desserts, this game is for you!

row.name: Project Three Playtest
row.detailed_description: Project Three is a fan-made sequel to Half-Life 2: Episode Two, inspired by Mark Laidlaw's Epistle 3 script, which was adjusted and refined by fans to fit the cooperative story campaign. Taking a page from Half-Life: Decay and Portal 2, this game puts you in the shoes of two main characters, Gordon Freeman and Alyx Vance. Together you must travel to the Arctic, rescue Judith Mossman and work together to find and secure Aperture Science's vessel Borealis, before it falls into Combine's hands. Aside from the classic obstacles, you'll also face the harsh polar climate along the way and in order to make it through these dangers, you'll have to cooperate. As Gordon, you'll mostly experience action with familiar weapons from Half-Life 2 and minor puzzles, your main goal will be to protect Alyx and escort her to Borealis. As Alyx, you'll experience style similar to Half-Life: Alyx, weapons will be scarce and it will mainly focus on puzzles, agility and stealth. She'll be too fragile in combat, thus you'll have to rely on Gordon. The Game also includes classic Deathmatch and Zombie survival mode. Key elements: • Cooperative campaign featuring Gordon and Alyx, inspired by the Epistle 3 script • Multiplayer Deathmatch and Zombie survival modes • Gordon a Alyx have different play styles, HUD and weapon arsenals

row.name: QuantumVR
row.detailed_description: Learn to solve quantum algorithms in a playful way with QuantumVR. The game is based on escape elements in virtual reality (VR). The QuantumVR-App was developed at the Technische Universität Braunschweig in the project QuantumVR (FKZ 13N15399) in the frame of the funding initiative “Quantum aktiv” by the Bundesministeriums für Bildung und Forschung.
row.short_description: QuantumVR is a virtual reality game that teaches you to solve small quantum algorithms by placing simple quantum gates. In addition, a 2D version is available.

row.name: Odium
row.detailed_description: Odium is A fast paced Action Roguelike, following Chris's life as a bullied child, in a subtle and parodic interpretation of his subconscious release of anger and frustration from his life inside his dreams. Gameplay Battle your way through each room by defeating powerful enemies! Collect coins and abilities to create the best build to fit your playstyle! Face and defeat Chad - the big boss! Story Odium follows the life of Chris, a young student who is being bullied for as long as he can remember. Chris's Dad left long ago and even though his mom is there, present in the moment, she is distant emotionally and not supportive, actually making things worse. In his dreams, Chris is back at school and his life hardships manifest as monsters. But in his dreams, Chris has the power to fight back! and defeat the monsters! Battle your way to Chad, the big boss! defeat him, and break free from all the bullying and suffering! Features * Fast paced combat * Use powerful abilities combination to destroy your enemies * 4 unique starting points to increase playability * Over 10 unique abilities, and over 60 ability combinations * Each failure is a chance to try a different ability and progress the story Side Note Odium is our Graduation Project from Tiltan School of Design & Visual Communication. We made the game in our free time, with love! All assets, models, textures, and sounds were created by our small team. We hope you enjoy playing Odium, we encourage you to question your actions and we challenge you to see the unspoken message in Odium.
row.short_description: Odium is a fast paced Action Roguelike where you follow Chris's life as a bullied child, in a subtle and parodic interpretation of his subconscious release of anger and frustration from his life inside his dreams.

row.name: Abigor
row.detailed_description: In the world of Abigor, humans must constantly live with the threat of demon invasions from another realm. Their vicious and unpredictable attacks have claimed entire cities. To combat this, humans have specialized themselves into powerful demon hunters. Our story follows Alric, a young demon hunter who attends Alastor Academy. There are only three more days until graduation, yet strange events and numerous demon sightings have began to worry Alastor's principle, Headmaster Neithardt. Follow the story of Alric as he goes through the Forest, the Crypt, and Hell itself on a mission to slay demonkind and protect Alastor Academy! Will you, be able to fend off the demon hordes, figure out their weaknesses, and protect your school all in time to graduate? Abigor features traditional third-person action combat with a focus on dodging to survive. Additionally, Alric has the ability to use powerful enhancement magic that lets him switch his fighting style! Use the strong Dark Stance, the nimble Serpent Stance, or the ranged Light Stance. Choosing the right stance depending on the foe is key to victory. These stances can be freely swapped between, but keep in mind to manage your mana, or else you won't be able to use any magic. Slay demon after demon within the Forest, the Crypt, and even Hell itself on your journey to protect humanity! Abigor was made by a passionate student team. Thank you for playing!
row.short_description: Abigor is a third-person action RPG where you play as Alric, a demon hunter at Alastor Academy who must overcome incredible odds to protect his school from demonkind. Combat features traditional melee combat with dodging, but also a magic stance system which changes the players attacks.

row.name: Project Possession
row.detailed_description: A two weeks Jam Game This project is the result of a 2 week internal Game Jam done by a small, passionate and dedicated team of devs from Colombia . We used this as an opportunity to challenge ourselves into creating something fun, simple and polished. We hope you have as much fun with it as we did crafting it. The Game ' Project Possession ' is a 3D top down competitive 'Enter the Gungeon' type of game where the objective is to eliminate more monsters than your rivals in PvE arenas filled with enemies and traps. Up to 4 players can join a match. Each player starts out as a 'Ghost' who must possess monsters in order to use their abilities to rack up more monster kills. Each monster has different types of movement, attacks and HPs. Ranged attacks are strong but will consume mana. Melee attacks are weak and will refill mana. The player that has the most points when time runs out is the winner. Support We will make improvements to the game and it will continue to be developed. UI/UX improvements New mechanics and improvements in Gameplay
row.short_description: This project is the result of a 2 week internal Game Jam done by a small, passionate and dedicated team of devs from Colombia. We used this as an opportunity to challenge ourselves into creating something fun, simple and polished.

row.name: OneHanded
row.detailed_description: Short Retro style sci-fi 3d shooter-platformer with shooting mechanics, where you play as a cyborg shooting and escaping from enemies.
row.short_description: Short Retro style sci-fi 3d shooter-platformer with shooting mechanics, where you play as a cyborg shooting and escaping from enemies.

row.name: Diamond Skeeball
row.detailed_description: Diamond SkeeBall is an arcade game and one of the first redemption games. It is played by rolling a ball up an inclined lane and over a 'ball-hop' hump (resembling a ski jump) that jumps the ball into bullseye rings. The object of the game is to collect as many points as possible by having the ball fall into holes in the rings which have progressively increasing point values. Diamond SkeeBall Is a chat integrated game for streamer to play with there community. Features of the game: 1) Custom Ball Skins 2) Different Game Modes We are actively developing Diamond SkeeBall with new features on each update we bring to the game to keep the fun in the game without you going out and spending real money for each roll you do in the game.
row.short_description: Diamond Skee-Ball is an arcade game and one of the first redemption games. It is played by rolling a ball up an inclined lane and over a 'ball-hop' hump that jumps the ball into bullseye rings Skeeball is a fully twitch chat played game to play with your community.

row.name: Kach
row.detailed_description: Look for your loved one, but there is a 'kach'. Kach is a First-person Horror Walking Simulator. Features: Explore - Navigate an abandoned house, and find secrets along the journey. Environmental Storytelling - Interact and examine interesting objects and unveil the mystery. Unique Visuals - Enjoy an atmospheric experience in a pixelated monochromatic art style. Story - Jump into an immersive world as you uncover the truth. This game was developed by a team of two from USC Games in collaboration with Berklee College of Music and Otis College of Art and Design. Playtime is around 12 - 20 minutes depending on your playstyle.
row.short_description: On a task to find your sister, you find yourself exploring an old abandoned house. But you soon find out that things are not as they seem.

row.name: Koishi Navigation Desktop Youkai
row.detailed_description: Komeiji Koishi, the popular character of Touhou Project, has come to your desktop! This is a cute desktop pet - Desktop Youkai. It would be great if everyone who likes Touhou Project or loves Koishi could like her~ illustrator：五月梅花落 Art：DD CV：闲踏梧桐 You Can： Touch her Feed her Chat with her The keywords that will trigger chat statements are in 【maindialogue.xlsx】 in the 【./mods/dialogues】folder And set up your own unique interactive response Daily lottery Just look at today's luck, don't worry about it~ You can watch her disappear on the table, wander around, and sometimes come up with strange lines.（The【Koishi Won't Trick】switch needs to be turned off） You can also teach her many new dialogues by yourself, or share the documents of teaching dialogues with others. How will the monster girl from the ground respond to your greetings? Maybe it will make a big fuss on your desk.
row.short_description: Komeiji Koishi, the popular character of Touhou Project, has come to your desktop! This is a cute desktop pet - Desktop Youkai. You can touch her, feed her, chat with her, and set up your own unique interactive response. How will the monster girl from the ground respond to your greetings?

row.name: Songs from the Iron Sea
row.detailed_description: Developed by a team of 6 students from ISART Digital Montreal, Songs from the Iron Sea is a 2022 graduation game. Songs from the Iron Sea was made for 1080p resolution. Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer scattered with environmental puzzles, taking place in a whimsical aquatic universe. Through a short one-sititng experience , the game portrays a creature lost in a metallic nightmare. Will you be able to get out? Your adventure start in a dark old factory, where everything has changed. Guided by a friendly entity, you must escape to regain your freedom. But stay on your guard, the foreman's gaze is on you.. Experience an original controller in our aquatic universe. Feel the freedom and smoothness of underwater movement and enjoy the transition between air and water highlighted by our platforming challenges. Immerse yourself in an emotional journey with delicate visuals. Highlighted by thoughtful environments, discover the story of this place through poems scattered throughout your adventure. Dive into a contrasted journey with strong atmospheres. From worries to relief, progress in a communicative universe and enjoy beautiful scenery.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in a contrasted emotional journey with delicate visuals! Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer set in a whimsical aquatic universe. Guided by a kind entity, embody a creature lost in a metal nightmare and escape the foreman's gaze to regain your freedom.

row.name: TRAFFIC
row.detailed_description: TRAFFIC is a fictional story inspired by my own personal experiences, various news articles, statistics, and national incidents that remain unexplained. TRAFFIC is a First-Person Psychological Horror game about a troubled child in a home where he must deal with both internal and external stresses. You will communicate with your parents, do your chores, and stay out of the way. Secure the front gate and lock your doors. You never know who might be out there. TRAFFIC is about a family living in Wyoming as they traverse through the economic recession of 2008. You play as the single child in a family of three, along with your Mother and Father. Experience the gut-wrenching tension and horrifying story of TRAFFIC as you make your way through the days, doing whatever you can to take your mind off of the traumatic events occurring. Piece the story together as you notice tiny details within the dialogue and environments. Huge thanks to Unrested / Inksmith for creating the Art of 'Mother' used in this game. You can check him out on YouTube @Unrested or at @Inksmith Huge thanks to Bazookya for creating an entire TV show segment. You can check him out on Twitch @ Bazookya Huge thanks to Monk for taking my terrible MIDI music and producing it into something useful and awesome. Unreal Retro Shaders / DaveFace Rest of credits in game This game contains subject matter not suitable for those susceptible to the following themes: Implications of Domestic Abuse Implications of Suicide Gore Sleep Paralysis Home Invasions
row.short_description: TRAFFIC is an Atmospheric First-Person Psychological Horror game about a troubled child in a home where he must deal with both internal and external stresses. You will communicate with your parents, do your chores, and stay out of the way.
row.notes: Graphic Violence Domestic Violence Self-Harm Gore

row.name: EXS2～EthnologySister2：Structuralism of kinship system
row.detailed_description: ***提示：宣传片和截图仅为预告，不代表最终品质。后续内容已实机更新，感谢支持*** 剧情介绍 一位总是能露出温柔笑容的金发修女，将众人联系。 白发女子总是无言。 ［想 知 道 你 父 母 的 下 落 吗 ？准 备 好 ］ 浅冰背后，为何会有寒意深藏？ 战斗，悬疑，治愈，推理， 剧情持续反转 ， 不断的匿名威胁，绑架， 真相到底是 …… +类魔幻现实主义小说改编作品，兼具哲理与专业的学科知识科普意义 +多变的风格和剧情架构，体验“千层饼” +玩到最后绝不后悔的感染力作 赞助作者 可以购买steam上的赞助包进行支持，感谢！ （注：所获得内容除等身完整立绘、草图等未实际使用的素材外，均可在游戏中体验，对流程没有任何影响） 赞助者感谢 排名不分先后，非常感谢 镇北 ———————————————————————————————————————— bilibili账号： 周武znq19 QQ交流群： 809014371 神位纷争steam玩家QQ交流群： 959486513 个人QQ：769690776（烦劳注明来意） 感谢和作者想说的话 感谢您的游玩。 EXS2作为EXS系列第二作，没有大家一直以来的支持，就不可能有新的作品呈现。 真的非常感谢，大家包容地给了第一作很多鼓励、建议和意见，每一条我都认真读过。由于本人在经费、技术上的原因，无法全部都解决，但我尽自己最大努力改进。 诚惶诚恐，本作为了能取得突破，有着风格上的转换，我也有些惭愧地但也一定要跟看到这里的各位说真心话，我自己为了能多试出更好的故事，生怕自己丢失信念，第三作也将会尽快推出，还望大家能继续包涵和支持。希望这一次作品，能给大家带来更多不同的体验！ 本版目前为公开版，后续将更新包括但不限于人物立绘、CG、额外剧情、配音、续作等。 作者（本人）纯用爱发电，想能让更多人知道这样的故事和自己的名字，希望大家能帮忙多多推广，看到回应肯定能更加激起更新的动力！ 如果觉得剧情好评或游玩完本作， 请务必在相关评论区评论 和加交流群反馈！ 非常感谢！ 特别感谢神位纷争steam版给予的人设灵感和素材使用授权，以此同名人物致敬。 感谢张亮总，对神位纷争素材和人设的授权和热爱才能有这样的作品，我们才能放心制作；感谢半次元@Alimu，A劳斯的立绘漂亮而且负责得接受我有时候含糊不清的要求；感谢@纯音子对音乐提供的指导和大力支持，大佬提供的高质量背景音乐解救燃眉之急，并耐心筛选反复测试。 感谢每一个在制作过程中给予帮助和游玩的人！ by 小说＆游戏作者：周农卿 bilibili@周武znq19 2022年7月17日 ※ 素材鸣谢（排名不分先后）※ ·开发工具与引擎：PC版使用基于吉里吉里/KAG制作的The NVL Maker，感谢@全局变量D，没有d大的工具和指导制作不出本部作品 ·CV：冰糖（克丽丝 小艾 饰），团子（真理亚 饰），缘丁（爱丽西斯 饰），kkr（海尔普林 真理亚父亲 饰），唐鹤疏（维茨 打手们 饰） ·CG：Smile Tech神位纷争HD ~ Ragnania HD，半次元@Alimu，布库拉 ·人物立绘参考：Smile Tech神位纷争HD ~ Ragnania HD ·人物立绘：半次元@Alimu，殻子 ·文字框、UI：Nvlmaker，びたちー素材館 ·标题界面背景和游戏图标：半次元@Alimu ·场景背景：Smile Tech神位纷争HD ~ Ragnania HD，爱给网，きまぐれアフター背景素材置き場，winddorfBlog ，よく訓練された素材屋，（ｃ）安野譲，背景専門店みにくる，MoonWind，ぐったりにゃんこ，Studio-74 ·背景音乐和音效：感谢@纯音子的音乐指导和大力支持，无版权音乐 Royalty free music，DOVA-SYNDROME，AGM曲多多，若通音乐，Freeplay Music，Smile Tech神位纷争HD ~ Ragnania HD，爱给网CC协议，耳聆网 ·字体：文鼎PL简中楷 ※ 声明 ※ 本作品改编自周农卿同名小说《Ethnology X Chris：Structuralism of kinship system》（EXS2），文中出现的一切人名、地名、组织名均有可能取自现实，但与真实情况并不完全相符，请勿对号入座。如有雷同，纯属巧合。 本作纯属免费作品，仅供分享和学习交流用，作品中使用素材来源于网络，如有侵权联系必删。他人擅自使用于商业行为或导致权益纠纷后果则自行承担，均与作者本人无关。

row.name: Endometric Void
row.detailed_description: This is a fast-paced first-person shooter that is completely free to play :) This is a game with infinitely spawning enemies. In the game, there are 6 enemies and 8 weapons. Each weapon(leaving 2 of them) reflects the highest damage on a certain enemy. In the game, there is a page of documentation that tells you about each weapon and enemy. It's best to be played while streaming any sort of music you want. :)
row.short_description: A sci-fi shooting game, with dashing and 'freezing time' to freeze enemies in place. There is simple hip-firing for each weapon. Lastly, it's a free-to-play game. Whoever wants to play it can play it :)

row.name: No More Future
row.detailed_description: Anything can begin, and end, at a moment's notice... You're a young adult yuuman, living in a futuristic America in the late 22nd century. Though you had a life, dreams, and aspirations once, it all got swept away once you were diagnosed with incurable late-stage brain cancer; now you're stuck in a hospital, living the last few weeks of your life in existential agony, incapable of processing what you did wrong to deserve this fate. Everything changes when, one day, you're approached by a scientist from the world's largest mega-corporation, who offers you a chance to escape your dying body and have your mind transplanted onto an android synth vessel; the only catch being, nobody knows whether the process works or not, whether you'll survive the transition or ultimately perish. With little holding you back, you eventually accept... ...You awaken in your new body, feeling quite different from how you were before. Nobody can tell whether it's truly you inside the machine, or an AI pretending, believing that it's you. Not even you. In a world where technology's constantly evolving, advanced AIs are viewed with fear and suspicion and few things are certain, you have to rebuild your old life from scratch, convince those who abandoned you on your deathbed that you're still here, and ultimately figure out whether you truly are who you claim to be. About the game: NMF is a linear Sci-Fi Visual Novel: explore a high-tech futuristic world as an android, meet all sorts of new people and reconnect with some old faces, find the truth behind your existence and your purpose in this new world. The game addresses heavy topics such as death, suicide, depression, anxiety, and existential dread. If you are suffering from depression or are easily overwhelmed by these topics, I advise you to exercise caution when reading the contents of this VN or refrain from playing altogether. The game is entirely SFW, though there are some adult non-explicit jokes thrown in for comedic effect. There aren't, nor will there ever be, any explicit scenes or suggestive content in this VN. There are fight scenes in the novel that feature non-graphic depictions of violence.
row.short_description: In the last days of their life, a dying person takes one final gamble... No More Future is a linear Sci-Fi Visual Novel, where you explore a futuristic world as an android trying to rebuild their old life. In this strange journey, they'll question the very foundations of their life and their world.
row.notes: The game features, or will feature, discussions of sensitive topics such as death, depression, suicide or suicidal thoughts, and other mental health issues. The game also features, or will feature, fight sequences involving the use of martial arts, knives, swords, guns, and/or "superpowers". No blood or character death will ever be shown on-screen.

row.name: Pest Control
row.detailed_description: Days move fast in your little solar system, and so do the pests! Can you collect enough crops before the invading pests take over your garden? This fast paced garden defense game features: 24 levels across 4 planets custom levels to set your own challenge control rebinding my blood sweat and tears cute Kenney assets a little guy that goes around a day-night cycle like you wouldn't believe absolutely no plot It's a little game you go around hitting little guys. You get it. Have fun.
row.short_description: A fast paced garden defense game. Collect what you can before the pests take over!

row.name: Klaystar
row.detailed_description: Klaystar is a 2D precision platformer, where the player controls Klay, a talented boy with the ability to turn into a bouncy ball, along with his friend Malo. Set on a massive pillar connecting the earth and the sky, the ever-shifting world of Klaystar is filled with a myriad of unique and strange phenomena. Klaystar features eight chapters, each with their own story, unique mechanics, and collectibles. So experience the mysteriously wonderful world of the Pillar, as you follow two boys seeking to join the honorable Vanguard, an organization hellbent on exploring the eccentric world they find themselves in.
row.short_description: Klaystar is a 2D precision platformer, where the player controls Klay, a talented boy with the ability to turn into a bouncy ball, along with his friend Malo. Experience the mysteriously wonderful world of the Pillar, as you follow two boys seeking to join the honorable Vanguard.

row.name: Project: Swap
row.detailed_description: This is just another free to play first person shooter game on Steam which there are plenty of already. The basic idea is that if you kill another player you teleport to their location. Maybe that idea needs a bit of polishing but I rely on your feedback. Project: Swap is just a game that I made because I wanted to. This game is nothing special and I just want to focus on having fun developing it. Also I want you the players to Features that I might consider adding Character customization New weapons (Some sort of laser rifle) New maps 3p animation rework
row.short_description: Project: Swap is just a simple, casual, non-competetive 1st person shooter that you can play with your friends. Find sessions or host them for your friends to join via steam. When you kill a person you teleport. Thats the basic idea of the game.

row.name: Crypto Clicker
row.detailed_description: Exactly what it sounds like, a clicker game based around crypto. A relaxing casual game where all you do is click and watch that number get bigger. This is my first app/game release. Music: LiQWYD - Sweet
row.short_description: Exactly what it sounds like, a clicker game based around crypto.

row.name: Escape
row.detailed_description: Escape is our vision for a basic infinite runner 2D platformer. In Escape you run to increase your score, and jump over spikes and holes to keep the score alive! The further you make it the harder it will be to survive. So don't forget to jump!
row.short_description: Run to score, jump to survive! That's all there is to it. Go as far as you can go!

row.name: Notes From Province
row.detailed_description: Need help? Stuck on a puzzle? Stumped by a boss? No worries! We have a welcoming, helpful Discord community available to answer questions, or just chat about the game. About the Game Dive into a deep Open World that rewards exploration, solve clever puzzles with lateral thinking, and engage in unique, story-driven boss battles. Then take a break. Furnish your home, fish a little, and chill with your eccentric neighbors. Kyme's searching for a fresh start in the city of Province. Will he find it among the eccentric residents and their whimsical adventures? Or will he get lost chasing his personal villain, a grand thief capable of stealing the blue from the sky, the voice of a singer, and even the very memory of what he stole, leaving you with nothing but an empty feeling? Features Open world No dead ends, only new things to see and treasure to find Character driven story Even the battles have a story to tell 7 characters Each with distinct styles and roles, swap-able mid combat Equipment based customization Abilities and passives come from equipment that can be freely swapped to redefine characters Enemies worth reacting to Each encounter has a plan to crush you unless you spot the weakness and counter Decorate and expand your house Earn bonus awards based on your furniture arrangement NPCs with lives Each villager has their own daily agenda, situational dialog, and a story to tell the more you get to know them So much to do Crafting, cooking, fishing, dancing, finding a strange rat-loving man living in a hole under your neighbor's house
row.short_description: Dive into a deep Open World that rewards exploration. Solve clever puzzles with lateral thinking, and engage in unique, story-driven boss battles. Then take a break. Furnish your home, fish a little, and chill with your eccentric neighbors.

row.name: Nomori: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Add to Wishlist About the Game This is the Pre-Alpha page for Nomori. We recently transitioned from Tech Demo to Pre-Alpha and want to give players a first-hand experience with our mind-bending game. Play now and enjoy 18 puzzles with 60-100 minutes of gameplay. Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori. Change Your Reality Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself. Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits. Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles! Think Outside the Box Combine your Spirit Powers to create new outcomes; play with gravity and timing to make time and space collide! There are lots of ways to solve puzzles, and to look at the world around you. Don’t be afraid to get creative—perspective is everything.
row.short_description: Nomori is a mind-bending adventure game where you control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

row.name: Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls
row.detailed_description: Once upon a time, a girl made a contract with a magical familiar, in exchange for amazing powers. Unfortunately, their familiar was a massive jerk, forcing them to fight evil at all hours without pay. So the girl and her friends decided to unionise against their familiars, seizing the magical means of production! Magical Girls VS The Gig Economy! Join the Magical Science Angel , Genius Beauty Knight and Magical Girl (Provisional) 917B (Just call her 'Bea') as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics. Magical Girls are mysteriously disappearing, a suspicious new App has monopolised the magical job market, and something seems to be draining all the electricity in the city... Magical Girls VS Late Stage Capitalism! Take on the brainwashed zombie hordes in tactical, grid-based combat . Build the Cooperative Union of Magical Girls (and friends) by recruiting and training new magical recruits. Explore 'The Factory' , a mysterious multi-floored dungeon into which many of your friends have disappeared. Flexible (and delicious!) difficulty modifiers to customise your experience on the fly. Magical Girls VS Scheming Familiars! Commit copyright felonies to regain your image rights! Find out why your house is overrun with hideous, identical monkeys! Run their stupid magical cryptocurrency into the ground! Try to avoid the inevitable burnout of self-employment!
row.short_description: Join the Union of Magical Girls, as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics, in tactical, grid-based combat!
row.reviews: “Everything about this game makes me smile.” Familiar Territory “NOT RECOMMENDED.” Woke Content Detector

row.name: The Dark Egg Demo
row.detailed_description: Old tales tell of an island across the Silver Lake... A bustling island, once filled with people and treasures innumerable. Now, the island is dead and empty, and the only tale that anyone still tells is that of the Egg. It is a dark thing. A thing that will grant any wish you desire. And it is a thing... you must get. In this text adventure RPG, you travel by boat to an old island, intent on finding the Dark Egg. You will meet many strange people, and encounter things that should not exist, yet stare you in the face regardless. Every choice you make matters and shapes the story. You will solve puzzles, face enemies, and must explore every corner of the island to make it to your Egg. Of course, not everyone can make it. Perhaps you might find your ending somewhere else, or, like the others, decide your goals have changed along the way. The Egg will wait. It always has, and always will. You just have to take it.
row.short_description: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.

row.name: Party Bunch
row.detailed_description: Imagine you are sitting with friends (or alone :c) and absolutely do not know what you will be doing. Why not sue your friend for a fictitious article, or interrogate him with psychological questions? Party Bunch gives you such an opportunity! The range of anguish you can deliver ranges from simple questions to lie detection, fake lawsuits, and delivering pain through laughter! Agony Of Questions (1 - 8 Players) - 15 psychological questions that increase in difficulty! If you don't want to answer, give up. Double Agony (2 - 8 Players) - Same Agony Of Questions, but now the questions are put in front of each other! The answers are shown at one moment, so you can't change it. Pool Of Questions (1 - 8 Players) - Don't like developer questions? No problem, write your own, and mix them between each other. Nonsense (1 - 8 Players) - Answer a couple of questions and make your own shuffled story out of them! Truth Or Lie (2 - 8 Players) - Do your friends lie a lot? Check it out, spot the lie and get points for it! Court (4 - 8 Players) - Imitation of the trial, where you will take on all the key roles! Judge your friends, give words to witnesses, build a situation on the fly. Bingo (1 - 8 Players) - A grid of 25 situations that you must complete depending on whether it happened in your life or not. Make Me Laugh (2 - 8 Players) - Make your opponent laugh in 2 minutes and don't laugh yourself! Developers are very boring creatures who rarely release updates, and playing the same thing over and over is not so fun. So this person created a very simple mod support! With the help of the documentation, you can easily create your own content for the game. And also, you can download other people's mods through the workshop.

row.name: Nekomancy
row.detailed_description: Delve into the ancient catacombs and slay Eldritch beings as a cat crafting and wielding spells! Crafting! Craft spells with 85 different components! Spells are made with 4 component types: Patterns, Shapes, Effects, and Mods. Patterns determine how many effects or mods the spell can have and its firing mode. Shapes change how the spell is delivered! Effects effect what the spell does when it hits the target, freeze them, heal them, or even duplicate them! Mods change various things about the spell. Make it bouncy, make it explode, make it pierce, etc! Levels! As of right now there are 4 dungeon types that you will slay your way through. The Hills, The Catacombs, the Caves, and the Sanguine Depths! Each level is procedurally generated! Charms! Charms let you passively fire spells when a condition is met! for example: When HP goes below 50% > cast Self heal, or On Jump > Cast Fire Area! You can equip up to 5 charms! Altars! Altars can be found throughout the dungeons and usually offer a benefit at a cost The altar of corruption has a 75% chance to destroy your spell but a 25% chance to Greatly buff it! The altar of binding lets you cast a spell on the impact of another spell! The altar of sacrifice decreases one stat but greatly increases another The altar of dismemberment can remove arms for stronger spells! Movement! Wall jump, slam, and slide your way through dungeons with immense slickness! Nekonomicon ! The Nekonomicon is a skill tree with some insane synergies! Bosses will drop knowledge that can be spent in the Nekonomicon when you die. Be careful though, as you progress so will your madness! Cats! Unlock new cats with unique passives and different stats!
row.short_description: Nekomancy is a Magic roguelite looter shooter! Craft spells and vanquish evil creatures! Grab their loot and craft better spells! Make progress in the skill tree! Only the best synergies pass the test!

row.name: vivid/stasis
row.detailed_description: EVERYTHING IS ABOUT TO CHANGE vivid/stasis is a rhythm-mystery hybrid game that follows the fates of four girls as they get wrapped up in a mind-bending adventure involving organizations, mysterious disappearances, and the fourth dimension. The game ties together an emotionally intense interweaving storyline with varying levels of music-based gameplay... and more...? In the rhythm game section of vivid/stasis, you'll find yourself facing various levels of difficulty, with many options for customizability to play the game your way. Whether you're a casual rhythm gamer just here to enjoy the story, or a hardcore rhythm game legend looking to find a new kind of challenge, there's a good chance you'll find it here. Between 'Opening', 'Middle', 'Finale', and the extra-spicy 'Encore' difficulty, players will be sure to find something fun for their skill level no matter their prior experience with rhythm games. Unlike other traditional vertical-scrolling rhythm games, vivid/stasis introduces the concept of 'Bumper Notes'; notes that take up two lanes. These notes can be hit with either of the keys assigned to the lanes it falls under, giving the game a unique playability with strictly four keys, despite the six types of possible notes. The song list of vivid/stasis features well-known and prominent artists in the music game scene (Tanchiky, Camellia, Silentroom), but also shines light on a fair amount of lesser known producers (A-Saph, Lundy, Spehs, and many many more). On July 21st, 2022, Tsuki Tasogare went missing after not coming home before her agreed-upon curfew. An investigation was picked up, but after less than a day of little to no progress, her sister, Saturday, finds the lack of enthusiasm for finding her sister confusing, and gets impatient. And so, she decides to look into it herself. Alongside her friends, Allison and Kotomi, Saturday hopes to uncover the secret behind her sister's strange disappearance... and isn't quite ready for what she discovers. vivid/stasis' story spans multiple chapters and multiple game genres to tell a coming-of-age story about living with trauma from a young age, and what makes our feelings 'real'.
row.short_description: Rhythm-mystery hybrid game about uncovering the history of a mysterious system. The stage is set. Will you step up and play your role?
row.notes: The story in vivid/stasis covers the following topics that some may preferred to be warned about beforehand: - Characters frequently swear both in text messages and out loud with other characters - The story generally covers themes of unreality, trauma, and poor mental health - The game makes use of its status as a video game as a tool for its story - Some story content covers themes of survivors' guilt, grief and mourning

row.name: Bless Global
row.detailed_description: HIGH QUALITY, ENHANCED IMMERSION An aesthetically immersive magic world is presented through the grand stories and console-level graphics in BLESS GLOBAL. The exquisite medieval architecture, subtle facial animations, and stylistic outfits with intricate designs all contribute to a visually convincing world. With the help of the dynamic lighting and real-time weather system, every tree and blade of grass in this fantastic world is filled with vitality. TEAM UP, BE STRATEGIC, AND ENJOY THE ADVENTURE To deal with various combat situations, characters of each class have an infinite number of skill and inscription pairing options. They may also change their combat stance to a different class position in the meantime. The Crusaders, for example, are designed to charge forward in battles, yet when changing for a different stance, they may also heal allies at the back of a team, opening up a greater variety of strategies and providing each player with a distinctive combat experience. When it comes to dungeon challenges, both Team Dungeons (5 players) and Group Dungeons (10 players) in this game require coordinated efforts among players. Since each class has its unique position, players are encouraged to cooperate. Each stage of the progression is made interesting by the game's intelligent Bosses, trigger-style level mechanics, and interactive cutscenes. DESIGN YOUR OWN CHARACTER The game offers a highly free character customization system, allowing you to create a unique character from dozens of tweakable facial characteristics. You won't find another character identical to yours in this game! On top of that, you can make your characters even more unique by giving them different outfits and mounts. YOUR BEST BUDDIES: PETS & MOUNTS The game offers a wide variety of pets and mounts with distinctive looks. Be it adorable, majestic, or cyberpunk, you will surely find a style that suits your taste. Meanwhile, pets and mounts are more than just ornaments. They can significantly boost your character’s stats after proper cultivation. Being the embodiment of strength and beauty, they are the most trustworthy companions on your adventure! FOLLOW THE GUILD AND BE SOCIAL In BLESS GLOBAL, players from all around the world are connected through the Guild & Social system, which promises interesting Guild Missions and exclusive Guild Skills to help members of a guild grow stronger. In this game, anyone has the potential to become a business tycoon! The Free Duel option may also be manually toggled on and off, allowing players to engage in dueling whenever and wherever they like! It's time to explore this massive open world for hidden treasures and have a blast playing this mobile MMO!

row.name: Soulforged
row.detailed_description: Soulforged is a passion project of one developer aiming to create a game where players become a part of a living and breathing fantasy world. What makes Soulforged different is how your character is part of its persistent world at all times. As you go about your day, your character earns action points that you can then spend when it's convenient for you on a variety of tasks like travelling, gathering, crafting or fighting. The game focuses on the important moments and does away with needing the players to spend hours upon hours every day to progress your character, like almost all other MMORPG games do. Game pacing This is a slow-paced game and playtime is limited by Action Points that regenerate very slowly in real time. Travelling, crafting, gathering and recovering from wounds all require Action Points. There is also no way, in-game or outside the game to get yourself more Action Points or have them regenerate faster. There are however in-game means to help yourself by making actions faster, meaning they take fewer Action Points to complete, enabling you to achieve more with the same amount of Action Points. Pricing The entire game is completely free to play. On top of that I am committed to having no other monetization tied to the game. There will be no upfront cost, no micro-transactions, no macro-transactions, no in-game purchases, no purchasable cosmetic items, no loot boxes, no expansions nor 'DLC'. You simply get access to the entire game for free and whatever you attain in the game - that'll be all through in-game means. Feature list While the game is currently under development there's already a large number of features included in the game. The list below is not meant to be exhaustive, but more to outline the current state of the game. A starting location which includes some guidance Multiple large and distinct areas Resources, items and monster names all dynamically named by the players Hunting, fishing, mining and other gathering professions Robust research & discovery system Crafting & equipment management Building construction, including player housing and housing decorations Player-made towns, roads, bridges and other infrastructure Meaningful character skills and statistics Complex and involved wound and healing system Farming - grow and harvest plants on your own farm Hostile creatures and combat system F.A.Q Q. How do I get more Action Points? A. You need to wait. You don't need to keep the game running - you can close it and just check later to use the Action Points you get. Q. So there's only so much I can do in the game every day? A. Yes, there's a limit, but you have a lot of control over how much you can achieve in a day. Most important is your character's mood - the better the mood the fewer Action Points each action will take. Avoiding injuries and pain, making sure you are well fed, hydrated and clean - all this will help your character keep your mood up and do more with their Action Points. Q. I am joining late and everyone has better gear and tools than I do. How can I get those? A. The game is designed so that all content, crafts and monster remain relevant throughout the game. Even starting resources are worth collecting and many players will be interested in exchanging them for some more advanced equipment and support. Q. My character is weak compared to other players. How can I level my skills to compete with older players? A. Characters in Soulforged age and die. Dying means all the skills and attributes are lost and that player will then need to create a new character. No single character can provide a high quality crafts forever. Q. So if my character dies I have to start all over again? A. When your character dies the skills and attributes they had are all lost. But there are things that carry over! Your Essence (in-game currency), discovered recipes and powers carry over. You also retain ownership of your buildings and will have access to all items that are stored there. Q. What is Essence and how do I get it? A. Essence is an in-game currency used primarily to empower and develop your character. There are two main ways to gaining essence. You can trade with other characters and get essence from them. But the main way to gain essence is by creating items and infrastructure that are used by you and other players and you will generate essence on a daily basis. The amount depends on how many items, how valuable and how many players were benefiting from what you contributed. Q. Can other players attack me? Can they rob me or my house? A. No. There is no interactions in the game that enables other players to harm your character or to claim any items in your possession without your explicit consent. Q. How do I know what to use for crafting? Is there a wiki I can use? A. The discovery process in the game is costly and that's very purposeful. There is no official wiki, the intent is to use the in-game research system. However, the community did discover multitude of recipes and they often share many of their findings. Check out our Discord server for a link to the document that players put together. Q. Action Points limit me too much. Can I just play using multiple accounts? A. Each player is only permitted to use a single account to play the game. Playing using multiple accounts is a violation of Terms of Service and risks getting your account banned.
row.short_description: Join our community on a fantastic journey across a vast, unique world. Discover new technologies, build infrastructure and brave new frontiers. row.name: Farm Wars
row.detailed_description: HOW TO PLAY Farm Wars is a real-time PVP strategy game where farming meets fierce competition. During the day, you purchase seeds, plant crops, and prepare your defenses. At night, you transform into animals to sabotage your rivals' fields, while they attempt to disrupt yours. EARLY GAME At the start of the game, each player sets a price for their fields. These prices are compared, and half of the difference between the highest and lowest prices is added to the starting gold of the player with the lower-priced field. This ensures a strategic balance from the very beginning. DURING THE GAME During the day, players can purchase seeds and defensive items from the shop, plant their crops, and prepare for the night ahead. Strategic planning during the day is crucial for withstanding attacks and executing undermine missions at night. ANIMAL SELECTION At the beginning of each night, players choose an animal to attack their rival's fields. If a player fails to make a selection within the allotted time, an animal will be randomly assigned. Selecting the same animal for two consecutive nights locks it for the next night, encouraging diverse strategies and adaptability. NIGHT During the night phase, players raid their rivals’ fields as their chosen animals. They can attack unprotected areas to destroy crops, but stepping on a hidden mine will kill their animal, preventing further attacks that night. END GAME The game ends when a player’s gold reaches the field price set by their rival at the start. If neither player reaches the target by the 10th day, victory goes to the player whose gold is closest to their rival’s field price.
row.short_description: Farm Wars is a real-time PVP strategy game where you compete to outwit your rivals. row.name: ChatFight!
row.detailed_description: Out of Early Access! [h1]ChatFight is out of Early Access![/h1] After far too long, ChatFight Is finally out of Early Access! Thank you so much to everyone who has played this game and kept it alive for all this time. The game has been out for 3 years now and I decided it's about time I finally get around to adding some more content and some long-requested quality of life features for all the loyal community members. [h4]Tournament Mode is here![/h4] Fighters are no longer confined to the chaotic battlefield where they all fight at once, now they can duke it out on the main-stage for everyone to see, one fight at a time. View the bracket and watch each match one-at-a-time to highlight each and every viewer! 1.2.0 Patch Notes Added the ability to switch game modes, allowing for potential additional gamemodes in the future! Matchups can be shuffled around, and then matches can either be played one by one or you can toggle 'Auto-Advance' to continue the fights. Press V for auto-camera, which simply rotates around the platform Or control the camera manually like BattleRoyale mode. Press Tab to view the bracket at any time. Battle Royale Auto camera is here! No more having to manually follow the action, now you can sit back and interact with your stream while the camera automatically finds the action for you! Press V to switch camera modes Press Left or Right arrow keys to change the auto-follow target Quality of Life Updates Advanced options are available now! Edit the the following aspects of fighters: Fighter Health Max Damage Movement Speed Attack Interval (Attack speed) Heal On Kill (toggle) Heal Amount Allow Overhealing And also customizable bot settings, in case you want the bots to be easier or harder than real players  Different Stats for Bots (toggle) Bot Health Bot Max Damage [h1]Thank You![/h1] Seriously, thank you all so much for continuing to play ChatFight! It means so much to me that even after the updates have significantly slowed down, there is still a community of players that continue to play this game every day. Thank you. About the Game ChatFight! is a battle royale for stream VIEWERS . Play the game on stream and let your viewers customize their characters, equip ridiculous outfits, and fight to the death! Perfect for small groups of friends all the way up to hundreds of people beating each other up in hopes of being the absolute best at a game of PURE RNG . There is zero input from the viewers once their characters are in game, simply sit back and pray to the gods of RNG that your character will be victorious. Practical Uses For This Game Stream Giveaways tournament Bracket Seeding Entertaining Viewer Interaction Mindless Fun This game runs along with its website, where you can customize your character, view leaderboards, and keep up with any announcements for the game. Twitch connectivity requires a Twitch account.
