In the game, the player takes on the role of Goku, who enters a U.S. military base to rescue his master who has been captured by Biden. A very rare TPS+Vampire survivor! Can use 6 big guns to crush your enemies! Can fly using the Nimbus Cloud! Rich build options, gun bonds combinations. Play as different forms of Wukong, with various active and passive skills. Bullet storms, a true bullet hell! Collect peaches from each round of battle, purchase enhancements, and ultimately engage in a showdown with the boss. A comically themed background storyline.
row.short_description: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue is a TPS+ROGUE game where players will take on the role of Sun Wukong, using three heads, six arms, and six big guns to rampage through the US military base and rescue their master.

row.name: Adventure's Calling
row.detailed_description: Travel the world, study, and test your geography skills by flying around in your house held afloat by balloons! Test your skills by exploring the world with two different modes: normal and aviation . In normal mode, you fly with a top down view, and can see almost half the earth at any given time. In aviation mode, you can test your skills as if your were a pilot, seeing only a narrow view of the earth and seeing countries from far more obscure angles. Study by flying around the world with country labels, and even find the shortest path to the country. Check your progress by monitoring the Atlas to see which country locations you are particularly strong strong at, and which need some work. Play with your friends and compete to get the highest score on the leaderboard! I hope you enjoy my passion project, which involved figuring out the best ways to 3D model the planet to make a beautiful experience! I know some of the datasets containing country data might be slightly outdated, so please leave feedback and I will do my best to adjust the numbers. Thank you! Credits: Major credit to Lee (@kirbeedia) for the box art and Victoria Tan for the store asset art! You all are amazing, thank you for helping me out! :)
row.short_description: Adventure's Calling is a relaxing educational game that tests your geography skills by flying around the world in a house held up by balloons!

row.name: Last Chance in Xollywood
row.detailed_description: Live the life of an extraterrestrial movie director in the intergalactic future. You work for Last Chance Productions, a low-budget movie studio full of sleazy, desperate, and eccentric aliens. Will you risk your health, sanity, and ideals to get the movie done on time and under budget? It's a living! Sort of. Last Chance in Xollywood takes place in Ingress, an alien metropolis orbiting Earth and populated by people from across the galaxy. Beneath its shiny, cosmopolitan surface lurks inequality and corruption on a galactic level. At least the rent is cheap! (It's not.) Make movies, make money, make friends, or fail spectacularly in this highly interactive RPG/visual novel. Last Chance in Xollywood is completely free. Although the Special Edition DLC adds another playable character and some additional scenes, the base game can be fully experienced for free without the DLC. Feature s 3 playable characters, each with their own story: Be a grizzled movie-making veteran, an idealistic kid fresh from art school, or a family man trying to support his twenty-three kids. RPG skill system with 9 stats: Use your persuasion, creativity, technical knowledge, connections, or financial know-how to overcome challenges. Relationship system with 8 characters to befriend or antagonize: You can't make everyone love you, and you probably won't even want to. 6-8 hours and 100,000+ words Countless choices and endings! (Seriously, there are a lot.)
row.short_description: In this sci-fi RPG/visual novel, you are an extraterrestrial movie director at a low-budget movie studio. Struggle against capitalism, corruption, and your eccentric coworkers to get the movie done on time and under budget.
row.notes: swearing, alcohol use, references to sex

row.name: SANGOKU XIANGQI
row.detailed_description: Authentic Sangokushi strategy board game This game is a strategy board game set in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Victory is achieved by taking the headquarters or defeating a unit (piece) with a military commander. Command a variety of units with different abilities and aim for victory! Fight strong opponents in online battles! This game supports online battles. Enjoy playing against players from all over the world! Form a formation considering offense and defense! Before the battle, you can freely arrange various pieces and form a formation. The key to victory is to think about the balance between offense and defense and form a formation. A big damage attack from behind the piece! Pieces are vulnerable to attacks from behind. It is also an important strategy to take advantage of mobility and attack from the side or from behind. Summon a warlord using the Warlord Souls! Collect beautiful warlord cards! You can get Warlord Souls by winning battles or by making purchases. You can summon new warlords by using warlord souls. Collect unique military commander cards and use them properly in battle. Purchase weapons and schemes with rewards! If you win the battle, you will get 'Wu Zhu Coin'. If you go to the store, you can buy weapons and schemes for Wu Zhu Coin. Make full use of weapons and strategies to advance the battlefield more favorably.
row.short_description: A strategy board game set in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Combine various soldiers with generals and command your troops to aim for victory!

row.name: Lightspeed Dating
row.detailed_description: How well do you know your friends really? How well do you know their mannerisms, their speech patterns, their secrets? If they were replaced by a shapeshifting monster, becoming indistinguishable by sound and appearance alone, would you still be able to tell them apart? And, if you were to be that shapeshifting monster, do you know them well enough... to become them? Features Endless, chaotic fun, best enjoyed with 4 - 8 of your friends An AI-powered voice scrambler, that makes voices almost entirely unrecognizable Take on your friends identity as a shapeshifter set loose in a dating show Pay attention to word choices, opinions and speech patterns to figure out your opponents identity in tense one-on-one conversations Lightspeed Dating is primarily intended to be played with friends or acquaintances and requires at least 4 people to be played properly. At this point there is no public matchmaking. If your friends are sick of playing weird indie games with you, you can join our super cool Discord server and find some new, better friends to play with! The invite link can be found in the box to the right. Social Deduction - Reimagined It's the year 20XX. In a future devoid of societal empathy the only path left to true human connection is through violence. Five of the universes hottest bachelors have been acquired from around the galaxy and as a shapeshifting alien is set loose upon them they have been given only two options: truly understand one another or die. In this revolutionary new kind of social deduction game players voices become indistinguishable from one another thanks to a new machine learning powered voice filter. Each round players get paired up in rooms together where they have to closely inspect one anothers 'realness', as one of them has taken on the role of a shapeshifting monster and disguised themselves in the skin of their friends, trying their best to emulate their speech patterns and opinions. Easy to Learn - Hard to Master As your voice chat partner judges you by your every word choice, claimed opinion and speech patterns, you have to both convince your opponent that you're the person you're disguised as, as well as that you're earnestly examining them on their own realness. Many strategies can lead to victory, but all require acting skills, smarts and, most of all: confidence. Hours of replayable fun. No round is the same! Intense, hillarious gameplay. Several question packs available in Deluxe version for different kinds of friend groups
row.short_description: A cyberpunk social deduction game for 4 - 8 players in which players voices are made unidentifiable. Perfectly copy your friends speech patterns, mannerisms and opinions to win in this intense experimental party game. Find out how well you really know your friends!

row.name: Monster Mystery
row.detailed_description: “It’s so much darker when a light goes out than it would have been if it had never shone.” - John Steinbeck (MONSTER MYSTERY) It is a 3 - 10 player Third Person Survival Multiplayer game where the players take the role of an Explorer or the Hidden. As the Explorer, the player tries to find out the identity of the Hidden. You do this by fixing Generators around the map that then turn on the Big Generator that reveals the identity of the Hidden. As the Hidden, the player turns in and out of the Monster forum to try and kill the Explorers without the Explorers finding out who they are. Vision: The night is dark and your lanterns are dim. You must refuel your lanterns at fireplaces scattered around the map, but make sure to fill them with boards because when they all go out all hope is lost. ITEMS: There are many items scattered throughout the map that the explorers will need to fix the Generators. These items are the Axe, Toolbox, Batteries, Boards and the Blunderbuss . The Explorers win by killing the Hidden and the Hidden wins if they kill all Explorers.
row.short_description: A game of survival and Mystery. 3 - 10 Explorers find themselves deep in the mountains of Transylvania. They must stay in the light or die in the dark for within one of them lies a monster. This was a student project which we plan to slowly complete over the next year.

row.name: Jam Scrapz Collection
row.detailed_description: NOTE: Some of these games feature DXR (DirectX Raytracing). They will be marked with '{DXR}' next to their name. Be sure to acquire the latest video card that supports integrated raytracing to access it. A collection of old Game Jam projects revamped, remastered, and rebooted for commercial and more playable value! More than a handful of games to play! Abyss Rush How far can your rocket reach the center of the earth without crashing? Steel Rain {DXR} Survive as long as you can until you reach the surface! 99 Cracks {DXR} A treasure chest holding a relic called the Cerulean Shard. Located deep in a cave at the highest peak of an arduous mountain. Frozen ice patches, unstable bridges, hot geysers, shaky mountain tops. 4 hours of pure exploration and survival. No guides. You are on your own. Valentide! You are Cordante Saint Valentine; an intergalactic agent of the Corde, a race of xenophobic bounty hunters and assassins sent to collect skulls to use in their 'Great Journey' expedition. You have been sent from your home planet, Amourium, to planet Tera (aka Earth) - the only planet not yet registered in the Amourian index, yet the Great Prophecy demands skulls of 'homosapien origin' and the so-called 'humans' are the key. You have been deployed by the council to collect as many of these skulls as possible and bring them back to your home planet. Gene-Soldier {DXR} The Gene-Virus War has just begun and the Cyan Genes are losing, being cut-down by the Crimson Viruses to the brink of extinction. You may be the last of your kind; the Last Gene-Soldier. It is time to carry out your mission and vendetta: Fight your way through hordes of Viruses in search for survivors, and hunt down whoever is responsible for this horrific genocide. And more (check the DLC list)!
row.short_description: A collection of old Game Jam projects revamped, remastered, and rebooted for commercial and more playable value! More than a handful of games to play!

row.name: Jewel Run
row.detailed_description: Get ready for team strategies and all-out action! Jewel Run modernizes the asymmetrical multiplayer genre and brings it online, on PC and mobile. Play as a team to defeat a formidable opponent or feel the thrill of defeating a whole team by yourself. Choose Your Team As a thief looking for adventure, team up with up to 7 like-minded youngsters to seek fortune. As Mr or Mrs Crosby, you will be alone to defend your quiet way of life. Don’t be afraid to use your strength and all the tools at your disposal to protect your goods. To Steal Or To Defend? The thieve's goal is to get through the garden's maze, shake the trees to get their jewels, and carry this loot safely to their base. Carrying a lot will slow you down! The Crosbys may be outnumbered and slow, but they can tactically deploy their clumsy dogs to corner the thieves, before taking them out with a precise tackle! Tackle a few thieves, and you win! Unleash Your Creativity Express your own playstyle with or against your friends: dash to become intouchable, lure the dogs away from your team, or take as many jewels at once as you can! Unlock outfits elements to customize your character, as well as map features that change the gameplay: alarms that will reveal your location to the other team, trick walls that will block your pursuers, bushes to hide into, teleporters… Each session guarantees fresh challenges and intense action. Warning: Jewel is free to play, but to unlock most character customization options as well as map gameplay features, you will need to buy the Premium DLC. If you play online with someone who has the Premium DLC, you will be able to play with them on the premium maps for free! A Unique Visual Appeal Inspired by the renowned filmmaker Tim Burton, the visuals of Jewel Run combine a dark and twisted atmosphere with vibrant and colorful visuals, creating a truly one-of-a-kind gaming experience. Players will experience a world unlike any other, filled with strange and intriguing characters and locations that are sure to leave a lasting impression.
row.short_description: Introducing Jewel Run, the ultimate multiplayer action game that puts a hilarious spin on burglary! Join the heist as two teams with distinct gameplay styles go head-to-head: Will the cunning thieves outsmart the magical orchard's vigilant guards, or will the guardians protect their treasures?
row.reviews: “Après y avoir passé plusieurs heures de jeu, nous ne pouvons que vous conseiller ce merveilleux premier jeu du studio français Cerbère Games !” jeu.video

row.name: Orpheus
row.detailed_description: My first solo indie game i started to work during my studying Two Soulmates separated by death. In this game, you play as Orpheus from the greek myth. Travel through Hell and prove your strenght by defeating all ennemies and obstacles with the power of your lyre. Orpheus is a first solo project i published on STEAM, started in 2022 for art license, i continue to develop it. In this game you play as Orpheus who go to hell for save Eurydice in a gameplay who mixed bullet hell and platformer. - Platformer and Bullet Hell Gameplay - 5 levels - use your lyre to fight ennemies and make bounce to eliminate them - inventory with multiple items given by gods - 3 levels of difficulty (Assist, Normal and God Mode) - Direction Key/QSDZ/Joystick - Move - Backspace/E - Interact - Left Mouse - Shoot - UP key/Z/Joystick - Jump
row.short_description: Revive Orpheus story to save Eurydice

row.name: Project R4T
row.detailed_description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. You will be tasked with completing tests, all designed around the tester's height and weight. Platform, collect keycards, and fit through small gaps in this short single-player experience. Features: You can make yourself larger and smaller with a simple press of a button. With this, you will be able to fit through small openings. However, your size affects your weight, so you must keep that in mind as you might encounter a pressure plate that will take your weight into account. Additionally, your weight determines your speed, letting you jump over large gaps or run through doors before they close. As you solve puzzles, the Overseer will observe your performance and talk to you as you play. You will get to know him, and the difficulties he faces at the facility.
row.short_description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. Take on a few tests by changing your size and weight in this short single-player experience.

row.name: Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories
row.detailed_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories' is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios for 1-5 players. In each story, you will face various puzzles that you need to overcome to escape. You must use your wits to their fullest potential to succeed. In the 'Jail Breakout' scenario, you are a burglar who, after an unfortunate turn of events, finds themselves in a jail. Can you conquer the many obstacles that stand in the way of your escape? Solve Puzzles From security devices to deductive reasoning, wide variety of puzzles await you in each scenario. They are sure to test your wits and intellect. Explore and Discover There are plenty of hidden collectibles for you to find as you make your way through each scenario. Work Together Play solo, or work together your friends, in up to 5-player multiplayer.
row.short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories' is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios. Each one is sure to test your wits as you try to overcome the challenges that stand in the way of your escape.

row.name: Apollo's Adventure
row.detailed_description: Apollo's Adventure is a top down educational game, where you take on the role of a wanderer who seeks the Sage of Wisdom. Along the journey you come across many characters and face math, science, geography, history and spelling questions! The game features 20+ unique levels created by the crew at nonPareil. nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of Apollo and try to find the Sage of Wisdom as you explore many levels and face multiple puzzles.

row.name: Cardboard Hero
row.detailed_description: Play as the hero of a young child’s imagination and fight your way through a cardboard third-person action adventure! Engage in exhilarating combat against a variety of enemies, find potions and reclaim treasures to grow in strength and take on tougher opponents, and explore vast levels, unearthing the ancient secrets of the lands you traverse.
row.short_description: Play as the hero of a young child’s imagination and fight your way through a fantasy cardboard adventure in this 3rd person action-adventure. Fight wacky enemies and find treasure to help you as you explore the vast worlds.

row.name: What if George Washington was a Girl?
row.detailed_description: A historical visual novel about history's greatest heroes and villains and their trials and tribulations. It is important to note that a lot of time and research was put into the writing of this game's story and themes, all historical people and events were heavily studied to make sure everything is accurate. This was taken extremely seriously and any naysay will not be tolerated. So anyways, the story starts with the Dark Musician (Mozart) plotting to destroy Antarctica. Georgia Washington (George Washington) and Teddy Rosebelt (Theodore Roosevelt), knights of the United Nations were sent to stop the mad musical genius before the icy continent is lost forever. BUT THEN, more stuff happens and there's intrigue and suspense and penguins? Find out more and meet other historical figures in this first chapter of an exciting new saga, Alter Historia. Yeah that's right it's only the first chapter, hopefully this doesn't get popular because there will be more if it does. Game Features Meet several historic figures like Georgia Washington, Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte), The Night Gale (Florence Nightingale) and more. Has an in-game wiki that unlocks exciting info about the actual historic figures as you progress through the game. Features a custom made visual novel engine. It currently has camera effects, map scenes, particle effects and more, with lots of other features being planned. Has an actual plotline. (It's sort of similar to Shonen stuff like One Piece.) Bonny is the best character. Parental Guidance Suggested, this uses some brief strong language like ' Heck '.
row.short_description: An historical epic following Georgia Washington in her attempt to stop the dark musician Mozart from destroying Antarctica.

row.name: Hex And Tricks
row.detailed_description: CHECK OUT THE IMPROVED GAME : Hex & Tricks is a story-driven card game with lots of puzzles ! Explore a strange witch world and summon little monsters while cooking weird ingredients to trigger special effects with the magic cauldron. The game is not yet complete but will be updated and stay free. As the old witch card game 'Cursed Cauldron' gets back popularity, a young boy by the name of Ethan finds a new passion for it. Completly obsessed with his new passion he gets overwhelmed by his own thoughts in his dreams and gets transported in the mysthic universe of the game. Explore this fantasy world along his side to help a lost creature find his owner back.
row.short_description: An adventure card game on witchcraft and magic recipes ! Explore the oppressive real world and the fantastic dream world. Fight colorful characters with your own deck of magic ingredients and monstrous assistants. Solve diverse puzzles to win cards and expand your collection !

row.name: 群侠传，启动！
row.detailed_description: 《群侠传，启动！》 是一个开放源代码的武侠RPG游戏框架，旨在致敬经典游戏《金庸群侠传》，并为此类游戏爱好者提供一个二次创作与交流的平台。 你可以在本作中体验样例工程《渡城残魂传》，扮演灵魂穿越附身于小乞丐的莫桥山庄掌门人“莫穿林”，解开自己死亡之谜。 你亦可使用本框架制作游戏MOD，并上传到创意工坊。 一切均免费，纯粹用爱发电。非常欢迎感兴趣的朋友加入。 但未经允许，不允许在本项目及其MOD以外任何场景使用本项目任何素材、资源（包括商用/非商用）！否则将上本项目的耻辱榜。具体可以关注开源页面中相关开源协议。 样例游戏《渡城残魂传》游戏内容： - 约3-4个小时的主线游戏剧情体验，可最终通关并解开自己死亡之谜，以及掩盖在该谜底下的阴谋 - 多游戏结局 - 多名风格各异的可入队队友 - 十余种可学习武学 - 上百种不同道具
row.short_description: 开源武侠RPG开发框架，并包含样例游戏“渡城残魂传”：你将扮演灵魂穿越附身于小乞丐的莫桥山庄掌门人“莫穿林”，解开自己死亡之谜。

row.name: Gods of Savvarah | Part I
row.detailed_description: 'Gods of Savvarah' is an interactive story (visual novel) in the fantasy genre, inspired by classic RPGs. Savvarah is an evergreen paradise hidden from the eyes of strangers. The godlike and all-powerful tyrant Ackotal has sealed himself off from the world and created his own state in the middle of the forest with a rigid hierarchy, at the very bottom of which are lizard-slaves. Hasvah was one of them. One day, however, the slave receives the chance not only to break out of his imprisonment, but also to change the destinies of other characters and entire nations. 'Gods of Savvarah | Part I' is the first part of the great adventure. The protagonist visits different countries, encountering their inhabitants, both ordinary people and gods. The world of Savvarah is ruthless, so the protagonist has to either fight for his life or die along the way. Our main features are: - An original fantasy worlds; - Dozens of characters, each with their own story and appearance; - Intense battles in every chapter; - An elaborate visual style and an original and diverse soundtrack.
row.short_description: Gods of Savvarah is a visual novel with the philosophy of a classic fantasy RPG. Defeat enemies, explore countries, make friends, and find your place in Savvarah.

row.name: Torch
row.detailed_description: GET READY FOR A WILD RIDE! Be brave young Player ! Push the door of the elemental dungeon and defeat your friends to survive! A crazy race with your friends Torch is a platform game where you have to jump and change elements to fit the dungeon platforms! This game allows you to play up to 4 players locally. Win the game by being faster and smarter than your opponents! A unique ascension Each new game, you will face a new tower to climb! Whether it be the type of platforms or their positions, nothing will ever be the same again... From heaven to hell The higher you climb in the dungeon, the more difficult it will become: the platforms will become less numerous, less large but also less immobile.... Only the most daring will triumph over hell... Controllers You can play in : solo mode with a controller or keyboard : get as high as you can local multiplayer mode with at least one controller + other controllers or keyboard : distance your opponent(s) to win the race !
row.short_description: Jump, transform and triumph over your opponents in an insane climb in Torch the elements platform game !

row.name: No men in this house
row.detailed_description: When a widow dies a painful death, she becomes an evil spirit. The ghost wanders around the village, breaks into locked houses, and kills the men who live inside. Does that sound like a creepy fairy tale? It's a folk belief that runs throughout Southeast Asia. Every year in Thailand, dozens of men die in their beds at night under unusual circumstances: they fall asleep, never to wake up again. Many Thai people think these strange deaths are caused by Phi Maemai, the 'widow ghost,' who can ravage entire villages. The 'No men in this house' visual novel is based on the Phi Maemai legend. It tells the story of several eccentric tourists trapped on an island in Thailand because of a pandemic. When one of the villagers mysteriously dies, the characters begin an investigation and conclude that the death may have been caused by... a ghost? Has the legend come to life, or are the creatures of flesh and blood at fault? Could it have been a tragic accident? 'No men in this house' is an absurdist detective thriller full of bizarre situations, erratic characters, biting humor, and twists you won't see coming! 55,000 words Non-generic, awesome OST (seriously!) 8 characters and a grumpy cat named Cilantro Story based on real events 30 Full HD backgrounds based on actual locations
row.short_description: 'No men in this house' is a visual novel set in Thailand. This edge-of-your-seat detective story about mysterious deaths on a touristy island will make you suspect everyone, including yourself!
row.notes: This game contains language that may seem profane, vulgar, or offensive to some readers. It is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

row.name: Dark Maidens
row.detailed_description: Story As a knight of the Church, Sir Galahad receives a mission to exterminate a group of demons. Through this perilous journey, Galahad will question himself and his faith. Will he obey the orders given to him, or will he fight for the affection of the Dark Maidens?! Gameplay Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. The game offers an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. The same goes for your enemies however. Do not expect an easy win as the in-game enemies fight back hard. 4 Fierce Fully Voiced Bosses 3 Maps 3 Types of Minions Fully Voiced Story 2.5D Animations Adaptable Difficulty Wavemode Also contains a wave mode where you can fight enemies nonstop. Prove you are the strongest and make it to the top of the leaderboard! Adaptable Gameplay Adjust the game difficulty to your liking with 5 difficulty settings ranging from ‘Very Easy’ to ‘Very Hard’. Whether you're a hardcore brawler or casual gamer, you can have loads of fun! Meet the Cast Abigale Abigale is a devout follower of the Church who was given orders to keep watch over Galahad and keep his sword loyal to their cause. Though she and Galahad have fought together side by side in the past, she has a cold disdain towards Galahad for having so little faith in the Church. Trina Once she was a part of the Church, but ever since she was turned into a vampire, she’s been reviled and hunted by crusaders and witch hunters. She still has kept a playful personality despite her past. That is mainly because she has never found the crusaders to be much of a problem because of her skill with a scythe as well as having vampire strength. She is very confident in her fighting skills and is very enthusiastic about finding Galahad, her new play thing. Slan Of the three sisters in arms, she is the eldest of them. She was born into the world a demon and ever since has been reviled as one. She’s not fond of outsiders, especially those related to the Church. So it’s no wonder that Galahad and Slan really don’t get along when they first meet. Gila Gila used to be an inquisitor for the Church. She made many a wretched soul pour their hearts out and repent for their actions against the Church. Gila is incredibly sadistic and very much enjoyed her duties, however because of her maniacal and chaotic tendencies to go...lets say...a little crazy, she herself fell under inquisition, accused of being possessed by the devil. She underwent the tortures she herself had inflicted on others and because of that became blind in one eye. She however managed to escape from the Church’s clutches and now turns her blade against her former comrades who did her wrong. She definitely has a hard time trusting anybody, including her newfound sisters in arms and fights with them...a lot. Galahad Despite not having any faith, Galahad like many had little choice but to be conscripted by the Church to fight in the Holy Wars. Though he achieved great feats in battle, he never was able to raise his rank because of his lack of faith. So he spent his days serving under his commander, Lady Abigale. Now having traveled far out of the Church's domain, will Galahad continue down the burning path of righteous blood and honor laid out for him by the Church, or will he take up the sword and fight for himself and forge his own path?
row.short_description: Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. It has an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. Don't expect an easy win as the enemies fight back!

row.name: Edge Of The End
row.detailed_description: Edge Of The End is a Short Walking Simulator, Emotional 3D FPS Exploration Game, Where You Play as a young boy who is going back to his beloved boyhood refuge as you go on an emotional trip. Uncover a treasury of love-filled and heartbreaking experiences that are intertwined. Get lost in the complex web of regrets and desire that makes up familial ties. Explore a moving tale as the son navigates the echoes of the past in his quest for closure. Are you prepared to engage in this sincere adventure and see the power of emotions? Unravel the tale to leave you with lasting memories when the voyage is over. KEY FEATURES Emotional and Heart warming story Explore the beautiful nature Search For Family Memories Short walking simulator experience Explore Houses
row.short_description: A young kid returns to his boyhood home in search of closure amid strong family ties and regrets while uncovering bittersweet memories.

row.name: Digital Pierrot Museum
row.detailed_description: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free digital museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through a virtual setting. This project is designed to give the audience a live adventure of the whole museum experience. This museum will promote digital art, contemporary art and virtual experiences. The floor plan and the architecture of the museum is devised so the audience can fully immerse in the experience, get lost, and interact. It’s an open virtual space in which multimedia artists can join our vision of making art accessible to everyone. Our goal is to promote art, technology and multimedia and to provide an open space to integrate and incorporate these mediums into the virtual experience of the museum. Using Unity Game engine and VR Virtual Reality Headsets technology to power up the museum experience, we are trying to further enhance the interactivity and the adventure of the museum for purely educational purposes.
row.short_description: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free virtual museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through VR and Windows platforms.

row.name: Metro Manager LA
row.detailed_description: **This game is no longer being supported by updates, but it's now free to play! ** Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy. Key Features: - Connect over 50 real communities around the Los Angeles area. - Shuffle workers around your stations and trains to respond to maintenance and crime as it arises. - Add new cars to an existing train to increase capacity on popular lines. - Unlock new trains to ensure low wait times for your riders - Complete in-demand routes to claim rewards and keep your riders happy.
row.short_description: Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy.

row.name: Bananner Nababber
row.detailed_description: It's a nice sunny day in Neo-Tartaria and ruthless killer Harry Pippels and his pretend friend Humpty-Ho are guzzling down some sprutzels and racking up a debt at the bar. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when news about the Elder Demon's crypto schemes becomes public knowledge. Energy generation is diverted from the population into crypto mining, and if no one intervenes then the precious lives of all Neo-Tartarians are upended as the chilling Neo-Tartarian winter draws near. Only one question remains... What is a Banana Nababa? GENRE Bossrush Platformer GAME INFO Pick one of six fighters and enter the lands of Neo-Tartaria to do battle against the mystical Elder Demons and their evil schemes. Destroy them all one at a time in an epic 1v1 duel to the death, each one more difficult than the last. Sniff out mysterious hidden secrets to help you on your journey, and hold on to your hat as you witness the heartwrenching lore that will have you reeling for days. PROS  6 mildly unique characters  10 disgusting boss creatures  Strong anti-crypto sentiment CONS  Based on a subpar indie game from aeons ago  Contains 'jokes'  Retro 8-bit nostalgia childhood graphics and sounds SOUNDTRACK You can check out the soundtrack by Kyle Riley & Jacob J Ritz on Bandcamp!
row.short_description: It's a nice sunny day in Neo-Tartaria and ruthless killer Harry Pippels and his pretend friend Humpty-Ho are guzzling down some sprutzels and racking up a debt at the bar. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when the Elder Demon's diabolical crypto schemes threaten the lands.
row.notes: Blood, violence, crude humor.

row.name: graveyard keeper
row.detailed_description: This is an ancient and interesting merge type game Players need to merge three tombstones (or zombies) with the same shape into a higher-level tombstone When all the squares on the chessboard are full, the game ends and you will get a gold coin reward according to the points If you encounter difficulties and cannot merge, you can try to use the round universal merge, or use a bomb. At present, the game is offered to fans as a free product. Therefore, the option to buy gold coins in the game is unlimited (cheating). If you are confused about the difficulty of the game, you can directly buy gold coins in the game for free, and then use gold coins to buy props for customs clearance. In addition, we have retained some 'back doors' of the game 1. Using the right mouse button in the chess board of the game can directly upgrade the object pointed by the mouse 2. Press keypad 1, and then press the left mouse button to automatically generate a zombie 3. Pressing keypad 2 and then the left mouse button will blow up the object pointed by the mouse 4. Pressing the L key on the keyboard will delete all the contents on the chessboard You can also try to use this series of commands to construct an 'interesting' level. Ten years ago, we were trying to make independent games. Unfortunately, the environment was poor at that time, and piracy was rampant. After the game came out, the prison break version was soon released, and the free version was overwhelming. So the game died. Ten years later, after a lot of things, the game has seen the light of the day again. In order to give back to our friends who insisted on supporting us in those years, and to leave footprints in the dusty past, this commemorative version of the game is specially launched for pure commemoration. The comments on this game will be taken into account in the subsequent reproduction products. This game is developed with unity3d 3.5.6, and written with ngui and uscript plug-in visual programming. Now the plug-in has disappeared, and this work is also the masterpiece of this plug-in.
row.short_description: An interesting synthetic casual game

row.name: Rune Break
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Rune Break, the completely free time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and rogue-lite elements. As a solo developer, my goal was to create a game that everyone could enjoy without any barriers. That's why Rune Break is completely free to download and play, and there is no monetization whatsoever. In Rune Break, your objective is simple - survive as long as possible and gather as many gems as you can to power up your next character. With over 20 skills and abilities, you must experiment with different builds to upgrade your abilities and go even further on your next run. Face off against challenging bosses, unlock achievements, and use various points of interest to your advantage. But beware, the game is not easy, and you cannot hide. You must survive, or you will lose everything. However, with every failure, comes new opportunities to learn and try again. Rune Break V1.0 is finally here, featuring new bosses, new maps, new enemies, and many more surprises in store for you. Plus, with controller support, you can play the game with your favorite controller for a more immersive experience. Whether you prefer fast-paced action or strategic gameplay, Rune Break has something for you. With its minimalistic design and rogue-lite elements, the game offers endless replayability, challenging gameplay, and satisfying progression. You can unlock new skills and abilities, upgrade your character, and even experiment with different builds to discover the perfect combination for you. While the game has been thoroughly tested, there may still be a few issues or bugs that need to be resolved. I am committed to resolving any problems that arise to ensure that the game is as polished and enjoyable as possible. Your feedback is always welcome, and I invite you to join our Discord group to connect with other players and share your experiences. Download Rune Break now for a completely free gaming experience that's all about survival, strategy, and skill.
row.short_description: Cut down Thousands of enemies, from the undead to the mysterious creatures of the night to save the world from the impending doom, Rune Break is a Fantasy Rogue-lite where you fight hordes of enemies with casual elements.

row.name: Summon Masters
row.detailed_description: customer service coolstar.cs1@gmail.com About the Game This is a card and board game with the following features: Deck Building: Players can build their own decks to battle with. Depending on different strategies and opponents, players can choose different cards to counter. Tactical Gameplay: The game uses a 3x10 chessboard, and players can freely place cards to fight. Players need to develop tactics and arrange card positions and usage order within limited space. Different Professions: Players can choose freely from four professions - swordsman, mage, monk, and archer. Each profession has different characteristics and skills, and players can choose according to their preferences and tactical needs. Competitive Battles: Players can battle with other players after building their decks, and it is fun to fight with other people. Through battles with other players, players can improve their strength and tactical skills. Team Dungeons: In addition to fighting against other players, players can also team up with others to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Players need to defeat powerful bosses through cooperation and strategy to get more rewards and cards. Special Challenges: Players can participate in special rules challenges and use their intelligence to defeat other players. These special rules make the game more interesting and challenging, and players need to constantly think and try new strategies. Fast-paced: Each game is fast-paced (within 5 minutes), and can be played in short fragments of time. The fast pace of the game allows players to enjoy the game in a short time, while also being able to play at any time and anywhere.

row.name: Tiles II - Multiplayer
row.detailed_description: Tiles II is a minimalist battle royale where you play as a cube, alone against all or in team, where you must conquer as much territory as possible in a giant arena before your opponents! The game has several game modes: Normal mode Challenge your friends on the arena in a limited time, move freely in the arena and avoid other players from eating your territory. Elimination mode Compete in a battle royale where players are eliminated as they run out of territories. Will you be up to it of not being eliminated? Contamination mode Survivors, run away from infected players and tiles for as long as possible! Power mode Fight in a game where all the moves are allowed with the many power-ups! Arena offensive mode Challenge the opposing team by conquering as much territory as possible from each side and earn the most points to win! The game features a customization system, where you can choose mutators to create the game you like, as well as a simple map editor of 128 tiles by 128.

row.name: Different Strokes
row.detailed_description: Paint! Fix! Explore! A collaborative online painting game where players can create, edit, and rate each other's art! Check out the Deluxe Edition DLC to unlock 9 additional colors and numerous extra features: - smaller brush sizes - brush smoothing - straight line tool - canvas zoom - studio room for viewing your paintings/liked paintings - painting easel for saving draft paintings Your friend, a conceptual artist, has invited you to their latest exhibition. You enter expecting to see their art adorning the walls, but to your surprise, the VISITORS are the ones drawing the art — they’re even drawing over each other’s work! It’s up to you to protect the exhibition from being covered in artwork that is, intentionally or otherwise, truly awful. Gameplay consists of: - exploring the ever-expanding gallery - painting your own artwork on blank canvases - editing other player's artwork - rating completed artwork All of the art exhibited in the game is 100% created and remixed and rated LIVE by other players . Yes, we host all of this art and load it in dynamically. We hope that you will choose to fix the (inevitable) unacceptable art! In addition to the main gallery there is also a portal to the 'gallery of the week'. Every week there will be a new gallery with a particular theme. The main gallery is pretty crowded so your art may have a better chance of standing out in the gallery of the week! Paintings have a 'share link' button that takes you to a web page you can use to share your work with other people outside of the game. Player's can optionally create a user account. When logged in, any paintings you create/edit will be marked with your username. Other players will be able to click on your username to see all the paintings you have created. You can choose between setting up an account with a separate username/password that can be used cross-platform (Itch.io / browser version) or to login using your steam account in which case your account will always be tied to Steam. From the logged in screen you can see notifications when other players like your paintings and see how many total likes they've received. Join the Discord!
row.short_description: A collaborative online painting game where players can create, edit, and rate each other's art!

row.name: Speed the Card Game
row.detailed_description: Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game and it could result in damage to the cards -- so play this and don't ruin your actual playing cards. Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards. Speed is a game associated with the game Nertz. Speed supports online multiplayer mode over the internet. Test your speed skills against other players. Speed is a game for two players of the matching and shedding family of card games, like Spit or Slam, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards. If you have ever played Spit,Slam, or Nerts before you will love Speed. Controls: Drag the cards Objective: To play all your cards first. How to Play: Each player is dealt five cards to form a hand, and each player is dealt 15 cards face down to form a draw pile. If you are playing with jokers, you use them as wild cards and give each draw pile 16 cards. A stack of five cards, placed face down on each side between the players, serves as a replacement pile. Finally, two cards are placed face down in the center between the replacement piles. Play cards from your 'Hand' to the 'Play Pile' if the card is higher or lower by 1 number or value. A 3 can be played on a 2 or 4 and a Jack can be played on a Queen or 10. The Ace's value is 1. You can block your opponent from playing if you place your card faster. You can have upto 5 card in your hand at all times. Refill your hand from your 'Draw Pile'. First player to play all of his/her cards wins!
row.short_description: Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game. Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games.

row.name: POP SURVIVOR
row.detailed_description: This game is perfect for speedrun, as you have 60 seconds to complete each level. Your goal is to reach the destination of the level as the goal will unveil itself when all balls in the level are popped using cones with matching color. This game requires timing, patience, and critical thinking as you have to figure out a way to reach the destination in under 60 seconds, by efficiently popping balls. Avoid being hit by the obstacles and falling from the stage as you need to move efficiently to continue to the next level. There are total of 100 levels and you may be expected to finish in 2-5 hours depending on how fast you adapt and if you can figure out the optimal way to move around the stage in order to clear in time. Sometimes, the goal won`t open up unless you drop the cone.
row.short_description: Pop all balls in the level before you rush to the goal, in under 60 seconds. You need to jump, run, avoid obstacles to successfully clear each level. Make sure to efficiently pop balls or else, you won`t be able to clear levels in time!

row.name: Lost Skies: Island Creator
row.detailed_description: Lost Skies: Island Creator allows you to create your very own island for the upcoming co-op survival game Lost Skies. Create your own sky island full of stunning vistas and brutal enemies, then release it into the world via the Steam Workshop! Create Your Own Island The Lost Skies: Island Creator is a free standalone tool where you can create the island of your dreams or your friend’s nightmares. Form the basic look of your island using simple geometric shapes, then sculpt away until you get your island looking exactly how you imagined it. Want a giant cave system or mountain range going through the island? You can do it!  Decorate Your Island Create a beautiful island filled with lush forests and stunning vistas or an island full of mystery and danger littered with foreboding caves full of dense fog and dangerous ruins filled with enemies and traps. No matter what you choose, you will be able to bring your island to life! Create Puzzles and Add Threats Not every island is peaceful. Add dangerous threats such as enemy drones or create puzzles for players to solve to find treasure. How hostile (and rewarding) you make your island is up to you! Share Your Island with the World! After you’ve put the finishing touches on your island, upload it to the Steam Workshop for other players to explore! Change your mind? You can freely edit and re-upload your island as often as you’d like for everyone to enjoy! Join the Discord to join the active Lost Skies community filled with creative visionaries and eager explorers who are helping to shape the future of the game!
row.short_description: Sculpt your island, design places for other players to explore, and even set traps or create puzzles in the Lost Skies: Island Creator! Each island tells its own story; are you ready to craft yours?

row.name: Pep-Pel
row.detailed_description: Play as Pep-Pel, a magician cursed to be a small red goblin, in this fluid and fast paced platformer! Explore 8 unique worlds in the search of monstrous treasure chests that cursed her. Hundreds of hand drawn assets make up each world the player will travel to. Try not to be too greedy, with hundreds of collectables in each level, and medals you can win for beating levels quickly! Key Features -Momentum Based Platformer: Pep-Pel is a momentum based platformer, where the player runs through large scale levels. -High Replayability Value: The game is made to encourage the player to replay each level to improve how fast they can finish a level, along with having collectables in each level. -Unique Level Mechanics: Each of the games 8 main levels have there own unique mechanic, including; candy projectiles, rope, lazers, chase mechanics, wind, water, and poison -Robust Customization Options: Unlock many different costumes as you progress through the game. Costumes can be unlocked by beating levels or by collecting collectables. Momentum Based Platformer -Momentum System: run as fast as you can through each level to beat them as fast as possible. With a focus on building momentum as you play, skilled players will be rewarded by being able to move at extreme speeds through levels. -Curved Surfaces: Curved and natural surfaces are a main focus of level design. Using a system that allow the player to move across any style of surface geometry, level design is not restricted to blocky pixel surfaces -Movement Mechanics: Pep-Pel has a large variety of different movement mechanic. All of which can help the player move fluidly through levels. -Fast and challenging: Players will die often so player deaths are made to be quick and satisfying, allowing the player to retry quickly. Armour can be found hidden around levels, this allows the player to survive one extra hit of damage before they die. Level mechanics -Each level has its own unique mechanic: New Mechanics are introduced naturally at the start of a level and get more complex as the level progresses -Hard Mode: Hard mode levels incorporate mechanics from multiple different levels Visuals -Level Worlds: Every level exists in its own unique world, allowing level designs to be creative and involve anything that would be fun as a visual. -Color Palette: Each level is designed with a unique color palette and style to make them visually distinct. -Hundreds of unique animations: Pep-Pel is animated with over 150 unique animations. These are blended together in gameplay. -Animation blending: animations are combined as the character moves to make character animation more dynamic and natural. -Actually 3D!: Pep-Pel is animated as a unique 3D model using 2D stylization, this allows for more extreme and dynamic animations to be made.
row.short_description: Run through each level as Pep-Pel! a goofy red goblin thing. In this beautifully hand drawn game. play through tons of fast-paced and difficult levels, each with there own challenge to master!

row.name: Idle Clans
row.detailed_description: Idle Clans is a multiplayer idle game that aims to provide the classic MMORPG experience in a casual, easy to digest and far less time-consuming manner. If you've played RPG's before, Idle Clans will make you feel right at home. With almost 20 skills to train and a deep combat system to dive into, you'll discover a ton of fun and interesting ways to progress your account. Even if you're not a role-playing veteran though, we've put a lot of effort into making the game as easily accessible as we could! Skills are as easy to level up in as clicking the objective you want to complete and... that's it! Your character will take care of the rest - even when you go offline! Smith your armour, craft your weapons, enchant your jewellery to provide different boosts, brew a large variety of potions and prepare for combat! Enemies range all the way from measly turkeys to the bosses behind the locked doors of The Valley of Gods. Or if fighting things isn't your cup of tea, you could sell your hard-earned items to other players in your very own shop. Another large part of the game, as you might guess from the name, is clans! Create your own or join an established clan to enjoy a variety of benefits on top of the social experience. Clans have their own levels and a fraction of the experience every player gains is sent to the clan. With high enough levels and reputation, leaders of the clan can purchase upgrades that everyone in the clan benefit from. On top of that, there's shared housing and a shared vault that clan members can enjoy. In game you'll also find leaderboards where you can compete both individually and with your clan. That's just a fraction of the available content though - come give Idle Clans a closer look! It's free!
row.short_description: Idle Clans is a multiplayer idle game that combines the classic MMORPG experience with simplified gameplay and less time commitment. Features include a player-driven economy, PvE, trading, quests, crafting and opportunities to play, socialize and collaborate with other players.

There are 22 pentagon-pillar-like terminals in the field, and your mission is connect all of them to the server. While connecting, terminals turn yellow, and green if connection is complete. Guards are coming to stop you. Shoot them to keep yourself safe. Guards get faster every time, and more and more are coming. Guards sometimes drop a coin which you can pick up and buy upgrades.

row.name: Plane Accident: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Wield advanced investigative tools and immerse yourself in the intricacies of aviation disasters in 'Plane Accident: Prologue,' as you decipher the enigma of a plane crash using cutting-edge techniques and expert analysis. Your task will be to get to the site of the plane crash . With the help of such tools as a drone find the likely location of the plane wreckage and Investigate the crash site , You will have to mark the area of the accident, find evidence and take photos so that the entire plane wreckage is finally transported to the hangar. Transporting the plane wreckage is only the beginning of your investigation. To get to the causes of the crash you will have to reconstruct the wreckage of the plane , send parts for analysis or examine the black box . An integral part of any investigation is questioning witnesses and gathering all the clues to work out the true scenario of the cause of the crash. Experience a tantalizing glimpse of the aviation mystery world in Plane Accident: Prologue. But remember, what you see here is just the tip of the iceberg. Dive deeper into the full game to uncover a universe of secrets waiting to be revealed.

row.name: In The Darkness
row.detailed_description: What Is In The Darkness? In The Darkness is a game where you are traveling through a dark maze filled to the brim with monsters that have only one purpose: To eat and kill. If you want to escape this dark land, then you must venture into the maze and explore every corner to discover its secrets. But be careful! The monsters are hiding in the darkness, waiting for the right time to strike! Originally made for the 2022 GeoJam, the Steam release of this game features an expanded map and story, with new secrets and paths to explore! Art And Aesthetic This game uses flat, geometric shapes for a minimalist art style. This game also utilises Light and Shadow to create the feeling of a dark and dreary maze that you are trapped in. UI I have a strong belief in minimalist design, and this game reflects that. There is no flashy buttons or gizmos to distract you from the game. All you have is your encyclopaedia, and your map to aid you in your journey, each of which is toggled via a hotkey. Gameplay In this game, you'll use the WASD keys (or joystick) to navigate around the maze. You will also be able to use the scrollwheel (or joystick) to aim your lantern at your surroundings. Use these tools to journey through the maze without getting eaten. You'll also have your Encyclopaedia of Monsters, as well as a map that fills in as you explore the maze! Be warned though, death in this game is not so kind in this game. There are very few checkpoints, so death will mean restarting entire sections (only your map stays the same). Be prepared for a very difficult experience! Language support In The Darkness is officially supported in 2 languages: -English -Spanish The use of controllers is reccomended, but not required. Controller support is tested on Xbox controllers.

row.name: Mafia Pigs
row.detailed_description: Park city has gotten too rich, and the treasures lying around are just too much to ignore. The mafia has other ideas: getting stealthy and stealling the world’s largest Golden acorn would be a real coup! But who are the best thieves in the city? So begin the Mafia Pigs challenges: test your wits against your friends and other players online to pull off the most daring heists! But be careful. The city guards REALLY don’t want you grabbing the golden acorn, and they’ll knock you out if they spot you! Stay hidden, avoid their vision cones and get to the prize! Tired of getting one-shotted in the latest extraction shooter? In Mafia Pigs, use your brains and skill to trick your opponents and grab the prize - no killing allowed. KO’s put you down for a while, but you can always come back and snatch glory at the end! Use the environment, stealth and tricks on others to gain an advantage. Each match is for up to 6 players and randomizes the goals on the map. Find all the keys and grab loot along the way to boost your score. Use ridiculous powerups to beat your friends. With so many thieves and grifters invading their territory, the city guards are on red alert (when not sleeping off a big lunch, that is). Try to sneak around unnoticed, but see where you can slow down your opponents by arousing suspicion, sounding alarms, and setting traps. No players or guards can be killed permanently … the mafia doesn’t want anyone to get seriously hurt. Just a little roughing up and a few knockouts here and there are fair game! Play with up to 6-players in cooperative online multiplayer for Mac and PC. Create your own lobbies with friends or play in public lobbies. Play single-player tutorial missions to learn the ropes and uncover some of the secrets of the Mafia Pigs world. Find us at the following locations on social media:

row.name: Beyond the Mountains

A STRANGE LAND As Peter, you will slowly uncover a vast mystery as you attempt to save the world of Evalon from unthinkable destruction. With dozens of enemy types and hundreds of puzzles, you will have to use every trick in your arsenal to stop evil forces and save the world of Evalon. A COLORFUL CAST The world of Evalon is stocked with colorful and crazy characters, each with their own unique desires and motivations. It never hurts to talk to each person you meet! WHAT LIES BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS? Explore a handcrafted overworld filled with intricate caves, tunnels, hidden paths, and overarching dungeons Fight multiple enemies and bosses using a variety of weapons and items you will collect on your journey Explore beaches, towns, deserts, mountains, swamps, and a city of the dead Battle your way through a volcano, flooded lighthouse, abandoned factory, and much, much more Take a break from the action with fishing and minigolf minigames Get into shenanigans with a goofy trading sequence Immerse yourself with an original soundtrack of over 50 songs and hundreds of unique sprites and tiles Choose from Super Easy, Hard, and Speedrun game modes BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS is a passion product of over a decade. row.name: Synchronicity
row.detailed_description: As a small Indie multiplayer game, matchmaking with a small player-base is always a challenge. That is why Synchronicity implements ' Cloud Turns '. When playing matchmaking games, do not expect to play them in one go, but rather over the course of a couple of days . You will get notified whenever there is a new turn for you; as will be your opponent. That is not to say that there won't be the occasional match that is played live, but it probably will be the exception. For playing live games, I encourage you to invite your friends or join the discord and find people to play with that way. Synchronicity is a tactical turn based game. Maneuver your Units to outsmart your opponent and use their special abilities to the greatest effect. The game is split into two phases, planning and execution: Each round you can plan up to 3 actions for each of your 3 Units. Have them move across the map, Shoot along a certain path, overwatch a specific area or use one of their special abilities. Once both sides have submitted their plans for the round they get executed at the same time. Then you'll find out how well you anticipated your opponents moves of it its all falling apart. Any online game you start, both Matchmaking games or custom private matches , can be played synchronously as well as asynchronously: Synchronous gameplay is what you expect. Both players are online at the same time. Whenever both sides have submitted their turn you get to see the result can plan your next moves. Asynchronous gameplay means that your opponent does not need to be online for you to play. Any plans you submit are saved in the cloud. If your opponent has already submitted their turn you get to see the result and can submit your next turn to the cloud.     Notifications are send whenever it is your time to make the next move. You can register for either notifications through Steam or Discord. Synchronous turns: Plan 3 steps in advance while your opponent does the same. Asymmetrical multiplayer: Opportunistic hackers vs righteous megacorp? Idealist revolutionaries vs malevolent corporate overlord? Pick your side! Destructible and penetrable environments: Predict enemy positions and just shoot through the wall! Need a different angle? Breach some walls! Instant Replay: Missed something? Look at what happened in the last round again. Any detail can give you an edge! Practice Puzzles : Get to know the special abilities and mechanics with fun little Puzzle levels! Practice AI: Want to get used to the game without pressure? Try practicing against the AI! Cloud Games: Turn any game into an asynchronous cloud game. Don't have time to finish the game in one go? Come back later, the game will be waiting for you. The game was developed over the course of >5 years by me and myself: Simon Special Thanks to Jazz Mickle (queenjazz.gay) for allowing me to use her track 'super violence' in the Trailer and also a huge thanks to all my playtesters for the great feedback!
row.short_description: 1v1 turn-based tactics, online or vs a practice-AI in a futuristic cyberpunk setting. Plan 3 steps in advance while your opponent does the same. Mind-game and outsmart your opponent with a variety of abilities, destructible and penetrable environments and a good strategy.
row.notes: Contains depictions of violent deaths and blood

row.name: 求闻编年史 ～ Gensokyo Recollection
row.detailed_description: 游戏交流QQ群：915841393 这是一部怎样的作品？ 这是一部集成了东方正作、东方旧作、蓬莱少女绘幻想、西方系列等ZUN各个时期的作品的世界观，以九代阿礼少女为主角展开的宏大叙事向东方同人RPG： 拥有过目不忘能力的稗田阿求因一场噩梦丧失了所有前世的记忆。 为了探寻自己的记忆，稗田阿求跟随幻想乡众人踏遍幻想乡的每一个角落，重新见证幻想乡的历史。 如何操作？ 方向键移动：支持八方向 鼠标左键/Z/Enter/Space：确认/对话/调查 鼠标右键/X/ESC：退出 shift：奔跑或缓行 D：查看图鉴 P：打开凭依界面 Q：查看任务 F：合成 Tab：打开小地图（方向键移动） ctrl：快速对话 A：自动对话 战斗机制介绍 本游戏战斗使用半即时制，伤害使用物理/魔法百分比减伤。 敌人一回合能够行动多次，技能以角色物理/魔法数值的倍率为主。 存在完全凭依、光环、倒计时、瞬发、弱点等多种机制，等待玩家探索。 为何免费发布游玩？ 本游戏目前为抢先体验，从剧情展开上计算仅为预计最终成品的五分之一。 其美术、音乐、程序的工作量远不是一人能够在短时间内完成，目前还有很多素材仅允许免费游玩。 笔者希望能够尽快完成这个游戏，因此发布抢先体验版，让感兴趣的朋友能够看到本游戏的概念与潜力，加入到我的开发团队中。 最后，感谢您能阅读我想讲述的故事。
row.short_description: 这是一部以九代阿礼少女为主角展开的宏大叙事向东方同人RPG：拥有过目不忘能力的稗田阿求因一场噩梦丧失了所有前世的记忆。 为了找寻自己的记忆，稗田阿求跟随幻想乡众人踏遍幻想乡的每一个角落，重新见证幻想乡的历史。

The game features a lot of game modes: Challenge Mode , Main Mode. , Mission Mode. , DLC. and more coming soon! The Challenge Mode is super difficult! Let's see how you face this.

row.name: 仙侠世界
row.detailed_description: 《仙侠世界》是巨人网络旗下王牌研发团队自主研发的一款仙侠风格的大型MMORPG。现诚邀所有喜爱PK的玩家来体验这场别开生面的战斗盛宴，无论是跨区战还是本服对战，无论是个人战、小队战亦或是大型团战，都应有尽有！让你感受无时无刻都有架可打的激情！ 【中国传统神话，拟真实景呈现】 《仙侠世界》以中国传统神话故事和民间传说为架构，将人、仙、魔三个不同层次空间一一展现。游戏采用了拟真实景制作手法、清新典雅的画面风格来打造出纯正的修仙世界，再配合悠扬中国古韵BGM，让玩家可以享受一场极具上古仙侠风情的视觉盛宴。 【战斗玩法丰富，满足不同人群需求】 《仙侠世界》共有百余种PK玩法，给予不同需求和喜好的玩家，各自喜爱的战斗方式。在游戏中，玩家可选择1v1对决、组队PK、小团体GVG战斗、结拜战、宗门PK、仙府争夺战、神秘岛激战、幽州城争夺战、比武岛混战，沧海岛阵营战、跨区战场、炼心岛速夺战、野外战等多重多样的战斗玩法。让喜爱PVP的玩家们，可以在游戏中随心所欲的战斗起来，充分感受战斗的刺激与爽快！ 【GVG战斗更激情，随时随地想战就战】 不同于大多巨人游戏的国战游戏设定，《仙侠世界》主推GVG模式的战斗玩法。相比较于人海战术的国战类玩法，游戏推崇的GVG抱团战斗方式则更注重玩家的操作能力与多人之间的相互配合。而为了让玩家能够更好的在游戏中进行小团队的组建，《仙侠世界》还特别设定了有益于小团队组建的各类日常活动玩法。例如：无尽之塔、秘境、乾坤盘、十二重楼等丰富的副本玩法。再搭配上结拜与宗门相关的或任务、或战斗的玩法，更让小团队之间的成员关系更为团结密切。 当固定的团队形成之后，玩家就会自然而然的进行抱团式战斗了。当团队中的某一位玩家与其他玩家产生了冲突时，往往以约架为主的GVG战斗便会产生。而在宗门复活法阵和队伍传送法阵的加持下，玩家将不再畏惧高成本的死亡成本。只需点击复活或传送，即可瞬间返回战场，继续在前线进行激烈厮杀。也正是如此，战斗双方轻易不会认输。于是乎，类似这种多达数小时的激情战斗在游戏中总是四处上演。
row.short_description: 《仙侠世界》是巨人网络旗下王牌研发团队自主研发的一款仙侠风格的大型MMORPG。游戏非常注重个人成长，为热爱网游的玩家量身创造了两个全新的概念：全新的GVG（团体对团体）社会关系模式和双螺旋追求体系，相并融入到游戏基础架构中。
developers: 上海巨人网络科技有限公司

row.detailed_description: Wild West Dynasty About the Software Howdy, Stranger! Are you ready for an adventure in the era of gunslingers, cowboys and stagecoaches? Until the release of Wild West Dynasty, you'll find out everything you need to know to be prepared for the intense excursion into the American West of the 19th century. row.short_description: Welcome to Wild West Dynasty! With the New Hope Gazette you will receive exciting background stories and information about this iconic era as well as first-hand development infos.

row.name: Motherless - Season 1
row.detailed_description: Motherless - Season 1 includes: 11 chapters Season 1 is composed of over 10,000 renders, animated scenes, 178 videos, sounds and mini-games that you can play. You can enjoy over 8 to 10 hours of gameplay totally free of charge! Get your harem of beautiful women! Motherless is a captivating, narrative-driven visual novel intended for mature audiences. It follows the story of Sunny, a young man who was separated from his loved ones at birth and raised with little knowledge of his origins. Join him on a journey of self-discovery, as he reconnects with people from his past and uncovers the secrets of his forgotten childhood. In this game, you will witness the journey of a young boy who runs away from his private boarding school in search of his childhood memories. During this quest, he will unwittingly find employment with someone from his past... You can play the intro or choose to ignore it... We recommend you play it!!!! You will be able to choose through the relationship manager if you want to follow the path of any character. The characters in the game have different ethnicities and personalities, so you will be attracted to some of them. Will you be able to ignore them? The further you advance in the game, the more you will get caught up in the story and each character with their different needs. The game is a visual novel that becomes more interactive through fun mini-games and hilariously awkward events.
row.short_description: Motherless is a captivating story-driven visual novel for mature audiences. Follow the story of Sunny, a young man who was separated from his loved ones at birth. Join him on a journey of self-discovery, as he reconnects with people from his past and uncovers the secrets of his childhood.
row.notes: MOTHERLESS is an adult visual novel that contains explicit sexual content. It is not intended for anyone under the age of 18. The game features graphic depictions of alcohol consumption, violence, and references to drug use. If you are easily offended, this game may not be for you. All sexual content in the game is consensual, and all characters depicted are 18 years of age or older.

row.name: Cursed 3
row.detailed_description: In 2009 a girl named Jennifer was lost in an abandoned mineshaft. She was rescued by a brave man who studied the mine's history, but she was changed. That man disappeared without a trace... In 2019 Jennifer's friend Randall came back to their hometown only to find it in shambles. He took down an evil cult and the demon they were attempting to resurrect. He and Jennifer fled to find a new life elsewhere. Now in 2022 , Jennifer is restless about her destiny. Why did this all befall her? How was her family related to the ancient past? Jen sets off alone to her great-grantparent's abandoned house. Her father grew up in that house, and it may hold the answers she seeks. She will discover far more than she bargained for... The final chapter of the CURSED trilogy! This game has a ton of new features! -Same distinctive art style, but now in Widescreen and up to 120hz supported -Investigate the house in any way you choose. Non-linear progression with tons to discover -Look around every room and fight hideous creatures in full 360 degrees of rotation -A fusion of combat and world. Everything is now real-time, so fight or flight, it's up to you -Equip up to 4 items to quick-swap at any time for maximum readiness -Many weapons to find and build gradual mastery of -Gain stat points to improve Jennifer in whatever way you see fit -Over 10 magic spells that can be used anytime with a new sigil-drawing mechanic -Over a dozen intense boss fights to test your wits, skill, and reflexes -A massive adventure with even more difficult puzzles, enemies, items, and ways to solve problems than ever -Around 30 minutes of cutscenes tell the full story like never before (skippable for you speedrunners :)) -Over 10 hours of gameplay. New completion and playtime counters track your progress. -The biggest baddest CURSED game I could possibly make by myself. I hope you enjoy it
row.short_description: The epic conclusion of the CURSED trilogy.

row.name: The Suits Have Gone Mad!
row.detailed_description: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand new episodic horror brought to you by Blank Dream Studios. Unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into a dull world. Learn about the daily life of an employee at Blake & Whitley. Everything will be okay as long as you work hard and stay out of trouble... A business behemoth in the world, dominating the market in tone production and distribution. Employees are pushed to the limits with little reward. Theo Blue, an ordinary senior innovator at the company unexpectedly discovers color while working on a typical day. Executives witness this discovery and mysteriously demand for his apprehension. Business suits search floor to floor, persistent in your capture. Avoid them in any way possible. From the disappearance of a co-owner to the malicious business ethics, the company has a deep and dark history that they have been hiding...
row.short_description: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand new episodic horror brought to you by Blank Dream Studios. Unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into a dull world.

row.name: Merchant's Rush

row.name: The Longest Walk
row.detailed_description: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical walking simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression and suicidal thoughts. The game was created using audio recorded from a 54-minute-long interview that I conducted with my dad, which was then edited into this approximately 9-and-a-half minute long playable experience. The aim for this game is to help reduce feelings of isolation and encourage those who are struggling with depression or experiencing suicidal thoughts to reach out for help. Through my father's sharing of his personal experience in an open and frank manner, this game seeks to raise awareness of and provide an insight into what it is like living with depression in order to provoke discussion and help tackle the stigma about opening-up about mental health issues. Whilst my father's experience and the locations depicted in the game are specific to him, the thoughts, feelings, and message conveyed through his recollection of lived experience are universal. The Longest Walk is now playable on Steam Deck! Please use the following settings for best performance and subtitle readability: - Subtitles: Standard - Graphics: Optimised Players using a gamepad or Steam Deck can invert the Y-Axis by holding LB (L1) and tapping RB (R1) on the gamepad. This free game is part of a series of documentary-inspired biographical game prototypes that I am developing for my PhD at Abertay University - Funded by The Northwood Charitable Trust - and was inspired by games such as Dear Esther (The Chinese Room), Actual Sunlight (WZOGI), and That Dragon, Cancer (Numinous Games). This game is published under the Abertay Game Lab practice-based research group by Somewhat Unsettling.
row.short_description: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical walking-simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression.
row.notes: This experience contains strong language and potentially triggering content on topics related to anxiety, depression, and suicidal ideation. When life is difficult, Samaritans are here day or night 365 days a year. You can call them for free on 116 123 or visit www.samaritans.org. You don't need to face your troubles alone.

row.detailed_description: The Wandering Duelist is a narrative adventure game that tells a story of friendship, conflict and romance. As the story unfolds, the player explores a small and lively planet, where residents perform their daily tasks while often acting as obstacles and dangers.
row.short_description: The Wandering Duelist is a single-player, narrative-driven adventure game that tells a story of love, conflict and reckless actions. row.name: Star Trust - 3D Shooter Game

In this game you can shot with laser, missiles and powerful unique specials power of 9 different spaceships. In addition, those space ships have good mobility that you can use to avoid enemy attacks.

row.name: Downbass Warriors: Heroes of Maydamn
row.detailed_description: Game is in early access state. In DWHOM, player gets into a modern war conflict cituation with several sides and factions of the military campaign. Every player will personally experience what could be happening at war, and its up to you what game content actualy means, is it pathetic parody or harsh truth? We left it for you to decide. We, as developers, doing everything we can, to make the players expirience unique and unrepeatable with our brand new advanced gameplay systems you wouldnt be able to enjoy in any other game. The game is at early state of its development, but already features 43 various character injury types which have their own negative aftereffect on the player. Dont expect your soldier to have his full functionality after taking a couple of hits. Character has very precise hitbox, what copies his body structure, and with combo of simple, but fast and multifunctional shooting system wich allows you to shoot throw walls or even to ricoche, you will have a unrepeatable expierence. The game features brand new armor system designed by us from scratch, which lets you to place armor pieces anywhere on character and subsequently calculates its position, to exclude any collision in wrong places. Any resemblance to real life is purely coincidental. Currently there are only 20 slots for players. Join our discord : For any questions or suggestion : nikoniko5120@gmail.com
row.short_description: DownBass Warriors: Heroes of MayDamn (DWHOM) is a hardcore first-person shooter with nice physics, a trouble-free, enjoyable shooting and an advanced character injury systems. A unique, one of a kind character armor customization system was also introduced in the game . So what are you waiting for?
