row.name: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room Prototype
row.detailed_description: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room Prototype is a free, first-person, short medical horror experience that is an early rendition of the prequel we envisioned for Negative Atmosphere .  W hile no further updates are planned, it remains available as an archival piece. In this prototype, you control the S.P.I.D.E.R. (Surgical, Procedure, Intervention, Diagnostic, Emergency, Response) robot aboard the TRH Rusanov. You’ll perform two distinct operations: an autopsy on a cadaver to gather evidence and a surgical procedure on a pineapple. Guided by Medical Officer Samuel Edwards, you’ll gain an understanding of the core systems that have been substantially expanded.
row.short_description: A free, first-person, short medical horror experience that is an early rendition of the prequel we envisioned for Negative Atmosphere.
row.notes: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room Prototype contains scenes that are not appropriate for all ages, nor viewing at work. Content warnings include, but are not limited to: frequent violence, gore, nudity, profanity, substance abuse, medical procedures, mental health disorders and psychological manipulation.

row.name: Drag Deal
row.detailed_description: Drag Deal is a multiplayer game where you can play with your friends or other players online! It is a Casual game with minigames, currently with Rhythm minigame. Available minigame Rythm, hit the notes at the right time to earn points and win the fight! Customize your model Buy makeup, clothes, hair and more in the store. With dragcoins or diamonds. Earn dragcoins by playing minigames and level up! Or buy diamonds to buy customizable items.
row.short_description: Drag Deal is a multiplayer game where you can play with your friends or other players online!It is a Casual game with minigames and customize your model.

row.name: RUNGORE: Beginner Experience
row.detailed_description: What is RUNGORE Have you ever dreamt about a world where you don't need to follow arbitrary rules of your favorite card game? Like, making turns, or use a finite amount of manaenergyAP or whatever. If you answered 'yes' then I have a treat for you :) RUNGORE: Beginner Experience is heavily inspired by Slay The Spire and Loop Hero. It takes all the good parts from those games and smashes them together until they stick. This version is a prologue for the full game, and its features are: - Idle battles (very exciting) - Non restricted card-play. Have you ever wanted to play 100 cards during one encounter? Well, now you can - 3 heroes with different strategies for each one to explore - 3 levels to assert dominance over random mobs - Psychopathic tutorial guide
row.short_description: Card game mechanics - check. Real time battles - check. Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

row.name: Blindsided Labs
row.detailed_description: Key Information A tide of pixel-art combat rolls across the screen—your hand-picked squad on the left, relentless enemy waves on the right. Spend steadily-generated Energy to recruit one of three classic heroes: Swordsman – hardy frontline bruiser Archer – ranged sharpshooter who thins the horde Templar – Tankier, faster, and more damage! Once deployed, units march forward automatically, clashing wherever they meet. If a side’s warriors fall, survivors push on to batter the opposing base. Destroy the enemy stronghold before they topple yours and the round is yours. But victory comes at a price: each win beefs up the enemy army and bolsters their base with extra health, ratcheting up the pressure in an ever-escalating gauntlet. How long can your tactics keep pace with their growing fury? Key Features Pick-and-Play Strategy – Simple unit-buying at the start of every round; deep decisions in what you field. Three Distinct Classes – Mix frontline muscle, ranged support and tanky defense to craft the perfect battle line. Endless Escalation – Every victory toughens the next wave, turning early skirmishes into nail-biting sieges. One-Screen Pixel Action – Clean, colorful art keeps the focus on moment-to-moment tactics. Short Sessions, Long Mastery – Matches play fast, but optimal play and high-wave survival demand cunning. Rally your tiny army, sharpen your strategy, and see how far you can push before the ever-stronger foe pushes back!
row.short_description: Recruit Swordsmen, Archers, and Templars, then watch your pixel squad auto-battle across the screen. Crush the enemy base before its ever-tougher waves crush you in an endlessly escalating tug-of-war!

row.name: Ascend: Reborn
row.detailed_description: The cult classic action RPG Ascend: Hand of Kul is reborn! Lore The ancient prophecies foretold that once the Titans' reign had ended, one of the Three Gods would claim dominion over their brethren and seize a position of ultimate power. That time has come, and now your God needs a Champion. Will you rise to the challenge? The Titans In the deadly world of Ascend: Reborn, blood is power. As you discover the secret of defeating the Titans and securing your god’s dominion over the world, you’ll claim your place as a legend. row.detailed_description: Forgotten Lands: Online is a free online multiplayer RPG. Explore an open world without much limitation. ﻿Customize your character appearance through character skins and vanity items! (Displayed on the main website) The game was released in an alpha state, and is under active development. The game is updated approximately once per month. Max character level is 35, but is planned to be expanded to at least level 100. Server Reboot Schedule... The server will automatically restart itself every day. Resets everyday @11:59 (UTC) The server may be offline for up to 5 minutes while it reboots. *The server also checks if it is offline, so if the server were to ever crash, it will automatically reboot itself. Just please wait a few minutes if the server goes offline. Important Note About VPNs and UDP Connection... The game requires a UDP connection, which may cause issues if you are using VPN services. As a result, you likely will not be able to log into the game when connecting through a VPN connection. If you are able to launch the game but cannot log into the game, it is likely that you are using a VPN service or a TCP connection. Controller, Gamepads, and Steam Deck... You can play the game using a controller, gamepad, or the Steam Deck. However, you may need to map buttons. Button mapping can be done directly through the Steam Input controller configuration, or it can be edited in the game settings (options menu -> controls). Most controllers and gamepads have enough buttons to map all essential game controls. However, controllers and gamepads cannot be used to navigate game menus, and there is no built-in keyboard which would allow you to type text into the chat box or other input fields.

The game also supports single play game with AI players. ◆Mahjong is a game that requires skill. Our games are played by thousands of real users every day. More than 30% of users have played this game more than 10,000 times. You'll have to play that much and you'll be of average skill. If you are in doubt about the game opponent, please report it using the replay function. ◆This game has in-app purchase items. You can purchase 3, 5, 9, 30, or 50 gold items. Purchased gold can be used to exchange for game money, avatars, and other items. Many Mahjong players await your challenge.
row.short_description: This board game is a mahjong game played by 4 people or computer.learn and play by this App about the [Traditional Chinese Mahjong] and [Japan Riich Mahjong] Game.

row.name: Cut Master Spades
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Cut Master Spades, the thrilling twist on the classic card game of that will push your strategic skills to new heights! Get ready for an immersive multiplayer experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Sharpen your skills in single-player showdowns against challenging AI opponents or dive into intense Spades battles against players from around the globe in real-time matches. Immerse yourself in the action with an exhilarating first-person perspective. Step into the shoes of your character and feel the adrenaline rush as you make strategic moves and outwit your opponents. Collaborate seamlessly with your partner, synchronize your tactics, and outmaneuver your opponents to win rounds and claim glorious victories. Prepare yourself for intense showdowns and take on the top players in Ranked mode! Get ready to master the art of Spades in Cut Master Spades and prove your skills in the ultimate card game battle! Key Features: 1. Strategic Gameplay: Think tactically and carefully play your cards to outsmart your opponents. Coordinate with your partner, predict the moves of other players, and bid wisely to gain the upper hand. 2. Thrilling Game Modes: Explore a variety of game modes, including Classic Spades, Mirror and more. Play each mode with a partner or go Cutthroat in solo. Each mode offers unique challenges and rule variations to keep you engaged. 3. Competitive Multiplayer: Challenge friends or team up with players worldwide in ranked multiplayer matches. Prove your Spades expertise and climb the global leaderboards. 4. Custom Lobbies: Create and customize your own private lobbies, where you can invite friends or set specific match parameters. Tailor the Spades experience to your liking and enjoy battles with your preferred rules and settings. 5. Diverse Character Roster: Show off your personality with a fun character that gives off your vibe. Collect all characters for bragging rights. 6. Beautiful Environments: Immerse yourself in stunning and vibrant environments that enhance your Spades experience. Play in unique locations, whether its a smoky basement or a family barbeque. 7. In-Game Rewards: Earn exciting rewards as you progress, including new card decks, avatars, and customization options. Unlock achievements and showcase your Spades mastery to the world. 8. Fun Player Interactions: Enjoy lively player interactions as you engage in real-time chat with opponents and teammates. Celebrate successful plays, strategize together, and experience the camaraderie of the Spades community. Whether you're a seasoned Spades player or a newcomer to the game, Cut Master Spades offers an immersive and competitive multiplayer experience like no other. Sharpen your skills, form alliances, and become the ultimate Spades champion! Note: Cut Master Spades works best with an internet connection.
row.short_description: Quick, seamless, and HIGHLY engaging Spades matches between real people. Play with your friends, enjoy the classic game in immersive 3D with quirky characters. Match up online and climb the leaderboards or just have a chill session with your buddies. There's a table for everyone!

row.name: United heist
row.detailed_description: INFO This game requires two players and a headset for seamless communication. About Your crew consists of the best two thieves money can buy—no questions asked. That’s how it’s always been, until a mysterious client hires you to steal an unknown item. The target? Classified. The pay? Too good to pass up. Decide who will handle intel and who will infiltrate the facility in this high-stakes asymmetric co-op puzzle game. Unique Features Asymmetric Co-op. Work in separate places, using tools and solving puzzles to help each other. Engaging Heist Story. Discover a story with twists, multiple endings, and choices that matter. Creative Puzzles. Solve puzzles with new ideas that make teamwork essential. In-Game Voice Chat. Use an old-school walkie-talkie to stay in touch with your partner. Striking Level Design. Explore bold environments built to inspire and challenge you. Enjoy the game. ~ No More Sleep
row.short_description: Your crew consists of two elite thieves. A client hires you to steal a mysterious item. One handles intel; the other infiltrates. Choose your roles and master the heist in this asymmetric co-op puzzle game.

row.name: Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher
row.detailed_description: Everyone Socrates Jones knows seems to love philosophy— everyone except Socrates himself. A simple accountant from New York, Socrates was never interested in philosophical questions or the art of arguing. But when he finds himself debating for his life against a queue of famous philosophers, Socrates Jones has no choice but to expand his horizons in a quest to find the nature of morality. The classic game, rebuilt for Steam! Face off in interactive debates against a host of famous philosophers— and a deer repellent salesman. Ask questions and present counterpoints to find problems in your opponent's ideas and cut through their NONSENSE! A loving homage to a certain lawyerly game series, Pro Philosopher introduces its own mechanical twists to cross-examination gameplay, all wrapped up in a charming story and healthy helping of humor. If you've never played Pro Philosopher before, now's a great time to discover why people enjoyed it the first time around— It's free! And fans of the original release can look forward to: Greatly polished presentation! Higher resolution assets across the board! New 16:9 layout! Improved UI during debates. Improved UI in general! New gameplay features! Controller Support! Achievements! Dynamic conversation logging! The groundbreaking ability to save whenever you want! Additional script polish! A few weirdly worded lines are a little less weird! Em dashes instead of double hyphens! Double hyphens are a categorical evil. Perhaps a little something extra somewhere...
row.short_description: Debate for your life against brilliant thinkers, poke holes in their arguments and cause them to freak out— or just tell them their faces are ugly. NONSENSE!
row.reviews: “A critical (thinking) hit. It's funny, weird and thought-provoking” Rock Paper Shotgun “Great art and a light-hearted take on some big ideas” 9/10 – JayIsGames

row.name: Bogey Brian
row.detailed_description: Golfing for a slime isnt easy. Without arms or legs, a slime can do many things, but swinging a club is not one of them. Brian, an eternal optimist, did not let this dissuade him from achieving his dreams. He envisioned a golf game where he himself was the ball, yeeting himself to glory across boundless and whimsical landscapes. Believing no obstacle was too great, he kissed his mom goodbye and bounded off to be the inaugural member of his own golf league. Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to golfing glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience and give Brian some flare. Remember: 'Don't SEE the ball. BE the ball.' Use powerups to shave strokes off your score! Choose from 9 different powerup types. Mulligan - Make a bad shot? Use a mulligan go right back to where you were and reset your score as well. Sticky Shot - Stick to whatever you touch first after shooting. Aim Assist - Get a visual representation of where Brian will fly as you line up your shot. Rocket - Use a limited amount of rocket power to push yourself upward. Ghost - Use the ghost powerup to go through walls! Be careful though, as with great power comes great danger. If you stop ghosting while inside a wall, you will gain a penalty stroke and be sent back to your last position. And more! 9 unique courses! Each course has a unique theme and three levels of difficulty - Normal, Hard and Impossible. Some courses include: Grassy Greens Crystal Caves Spooky Strokes Galleon Greens Candy Country And more! **Note that the Impossible difficulty can be quite brutal. These are not for the faint of heart! Earn hats and Boge Coin! Earn rewards by completing courses with good scores. Buy and sell hats in the hat shop with your Boge Coin. Equip a hat to gain it's effects - over 10 different base hat effects with varying intensity, and tons of powerup modifiers. Power, Spin, Roll, Bounciness, Gravity and many other things can be effected by hats. There are millions of possible combinations! Several ways to play! Normal mode - Use powerups and hat effects to get the lowest score you can. Basic Brian mode - No powerups or hat effects allowed - get the lowest score you can. Speedrun mode - Complete each hole as fast as you can - strokes don't matter, only speed. Practice mode - Pick any hole on any course to practice on. Hone your lines and try new strategies to shave strokes off your score! Challenge mode - Choose from over 30 challenge hats, most with unique and difficult modifiers. Customize your trail! Choose the color and type of trail Brian leaves behind as he flies through the air. Random Mode! Play on a set of 9 randomly selected holes, with a randomly generated hat OR a randomly chosen challenge hat. Enter your own seed or have one randomly generated for you. Discord Server! Join our Discord Server to chat about the game and provide feedback to help shape the future of the game.
row.short_description: Play as Brian, a slime who dreams of playing golf - with himself as the ball! Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience.

row.name: The First Step
row.detailed_description: I want to start off by mentioning that this project is a learning project for me. I am trying to learn how to use Unreal Engine, and for this purpose I have created this game. It is a very simple item collection game. And only has 2 levels. The entire game can be completed in a few minutes. Still, I have tried to make the levels interesting enough to explore for a bit. As well as added a timer, so you can try to find the quickest ways to complete the levels.
row.short_description: Explore 2 levels, and collect all the required items. The levels are timed, so you can try to beat the levels as fast as possible. Or you can casually take your time and explore around. This project is only meant as a learning project for me. So please do not expect a complete game.

row.name: Chess for idiots
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer: I do not support Kor*in and other extremes. The game is a satire full of stupid jokes aimed at people with an absurd sense of humor. The game is not intended to promote any ideology. Chess for idiots - a discipline of intellectual sport, invented and initiated by Ozjasz Goldberg. Seemingly chess for idiots resembles regular chess. The game is played on the same board using the same pieces. However, this is where the similarities end, because everything that would discriminate intellectually against players was eliminated from the rules. Therefore, there are practically no rules, and players can make any move with any pieces and capture any number of opponent's pieces. The victory is determined by the IQ (the lower, the greater the chances of winning) and the decision of Ozjasz Goldberg. Weapons: Blowing Arrow Invisible hand of market Brushwood+ Wozdoopy Grenade Inflation Hot Sauce And more... True story: When I was going to primary school, there was this guy named Paweł, and during breaks I played a game with him which involved blowing own coin in turns to land on the opponent's coin. Years later, I met Paweł and we remembered about this game, that day I couldn't sleep and I decided to copy this game to the computer. In addition to the coin mode, I added a chess mode and posted a video from a very early version of the game on a certain Facebook group where someone commented that it looked like Chess for idiots - it is a Polish political meme referring to a certain statement of a controversial politician, then I decided that this game will be a political satire. The game is therefore simultaneously a recreation of a physical game from my childhood, a parody of chess and a Polish political satire.
row.short_description: The first intellectually non-discriminatory chess variant. Instead of thinking, just move your pieces in one of the many absurd ways!

row.name: Hermit Home Designer
row.detailed_description: Yamasen-Chan's Hermit Home Designer is a hikikomori themed visual novel and designing game. Yamasen-Chan is a hikikomori who lives in isolation and never leaves her home. She really wants her home to look great! Will you help her make a stylish and comfy home? Features: 6 unique homes to design Complete Visual Novel Narrative Over 100 items to design with Original Soundtrack
row.short_description: Yamasen-Chan is a hikikomori who lives in isolation and never leaves her home. Will you help her make a comfy home in this hikikomori themed visual novel designing game?

row.name: TimeLost
row.detailed_description: TimeLost is a Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time. Prepare for Battle Enter the arena equipped with two distinct weapons, each offering unique skills. Your selections not only define your combat style but also impact your health and dodge capabilities. Strategize and customize to dominate the battlefield. Master The Art of Defense Defend with precision by balancing blocks and dodges. Absorb damage with well-timed blocks, but depleting your stamina leaves you exposed. Evade strikes and debuffs with perfectly timed dodges, gaining brief invulnerability. Strategy and reflexes are the keys to dominating the arena. Intense Combat with Endless Strategy Engage in fast-paced battles where strategy and precision are key. Compete in ranked arenas, skirmishes, or control points—each match brings new challenges. Customize builds to heal allies, debilitate enemies with status effects, and turn the tide of battle. Visit the Black Market The Black Market is the in-game shop where you can purchase new Weapons, Stimulants, Upgrade Chips, and other visual aesthetics to customize your character and weapons. You can acquire currency from competing in matches. NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!
row.short_description: TimeLost is a Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time.

row.name: 东北之夏
row.detailed_description: what Kind Of Game Is This? DongBeiZhiXia (a summer in the northeast of China)is a free visual novel, which tells the story that the protagonist followed parents' wishes to make one's living in Shenyang, met two online anchors Huniu and Daojiang by chance, and experience affairs one after another with Shamate. And some of the voice actors are native northeasterners of China. Most of the backgrounds images in the game were illustrated according to the landscape of Shenyang. Compared with the previous video version, the game includes additional scenes, CG, and enhanced visual effects. More stories behind the scenes about the game can be searched in Bilibili

row.name: rotatePDF: A Corporate Tale
row.detailed_description: Taking the role of an employee, explore a strange company that has you... rotate documents? Surely this must be a joke, you think, and begin to investigate. Switch between 2D exploration, physics simulation and puzzles in this enigmatic art game. Features Paper Physics * Calm, Liminal Atmosphere * A short, linear Story And lastly, a word of warning: O player, who seeketh for polished and complex games - turneth thy heel and flee, for thine search is in vain! This game is a single-developer Indie title and tries to make up for this with heart and humor, but it way not always succeed.
row.short_description: Explore the liminal corridors of a company that only... rotates documents? This short artistic Indie title combines 2D exploration with paper physics to create a truly unique experience.
row.notes: There is one instance of still pixel blood and of a smoking cigarette.

row.name: Fall Minamo
row.detailed_description: 2022/9/17 Update Announcement We are happy to announce that We would like to thank Lime Anda, the creator of Minamo-chan, for kindly providing the music for this update. The BGM during the game and the BGM at the ending have been changed to bring out the cuteness of Minamo-chan even more. We hope you enjoy it! Credits VOICEVOX_Zundamon : NEUTRINO : About the Game This game is about you, Minamo-chan, being swept away by a waterfall. Game Features .The object of the game is to survive as long as possible, avoiding the attacks of the ferocious creatures that live in the waterfall. The longer you survive, the better your score, and you can enjoy a cute multi-ending based on your score. There are only two basic controls. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually. 'Move'... Move left and right with the directional keys. 'Swim'... Swim as hard as you can to raise your stamina a little. If you run out of stamina, you can't swim! Leveling up is important to defend against progressively more intense attacks. Collect Japanese confectionary to gain experience and strengthen your skills strategically. What is Minamo-chan ? Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends. By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world. Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan.
row.short_description: Save the lovely Minamo from flooding!

row.name: Dimensional Gears
row.detailed_description: Dimensional Gears is a 2.5D puzzle platformer that takes place in a dystopian steam-punk future where household appliances are the only sentient beings left. You play as Mike O. Wave the lovable microwave. You and your friends are stuck in an abandoned factory and must use Mike's supernatural ability to shift dimensions in order to escape. Make the most of this strange power to explore a dangerous 2.5D environment within a shifting, orthographic plane to escape the factory and save your friends. Shift between four different dimensions! This game's a mindbender! Pick up and throw objects to aid with platforming and defeating enemies! Dynamic music! Be immersed with audio that will constantly adapt to the situation at hand! The cutest microwave ever! He has some pretty adorable friends too! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Dimensional Gears is a 2.5D puzzle platformer that takes place in a dystopian steam-punk future where household appliances are the only sentient beings left. Shift dimensions in order explore a dangerous 2.5D environment, escape the factory, and save your friends!

row.name: Streamer Future Wars
row.detailed_description: Streamer Future Wars is a high-fantasy hero collection RPG gacha game. Embark on your journey in this most questionable mobile-port gacha game. Only you can save the future of streaming. Collect unique heroes from the streaming world Level them, awaken and power them up Gather items and equip them on your heroes Breeze through story with handwritten dialogues Climb in the arena to claim the number 1 spot Battle through 40+ story chapters with unique story completely new made just for this game. Each stage contains a turn-based battle between your party of up to 5 heroes battling versus up to 5 enemies. Deplete their health bars to finish the stage. Any casualties on your side will cost you a star our of 3 possible stars for each stage. Special currency used in gacha can be acquired by clearing stage stars for the first time and daily/weekly missions. Game contains specialized summons where you can acquire heroes. There is a hard pity of 30 summons for a classic legendary hero. There's also a special darklight summon that contains more powerful or unique heroes. This summon comes with a special currency and a hard pity of 50 summons. Every character in the game can be obtained by a f2p player after some saving up. Not revolutionary by any means, and barely hitting the minimum standarts of a gacha hero game, but made with love and care! Game contains possible events for seasonal times like winter holidays and halloween. Gather completely unique streamer heroes, train and awaken them and upgrade their weapons. Also possibly with battlepass and pay to feed devs darklight battlepass. However you can collect all the heroes and beat everything in the game for completely free! Free to play *In-game purchases are available *Please read the End-User License Agreement (EULA) from the in-game menu before playing * Saves from mobile version are not compatible with the steam release
row.short_description: Questionable Gacha game where you can collect completely unique streamer characters!

row.name: Cyber Attack VR board game
row.detailed_description: Be prepared to hack the ship AI and return yourself and your team back to the ship. This is the game where players can be at the same time inside and outside of the board game and have different gameplay, but it still will affect the gameplay for the entire team. Hack robots on the board (space ship rooms) and collect enough data to perform the Cyber Attack, but be cautious because the main computer (M.A.Z.E.) can hack you back and you will need to grab the gun to protect yourself. Robots that can explode and 3D puzzles will create tight situations, so be ready for it.
row.short_description: VR Co-op board game when players will fight against ship AI on board and inside of it at the same time. Hack all robots, and be prepared to protect yourself inside of the ship, solve 3D puzzles and help your friends.
